1.title: Grammar Auction: culture shock sentences
1.stage: Savol turlari tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
1.goal: Madaniyat shoki va chet elda o'qish mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: get used to / avoid + -ing, sanalmaydigan otlar, predlog (enthusiasm for), fe'l moslashuvi, so'z turi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Har so'zni T/F/NG dagidek diqqat bilan tekshiring.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'get used to eat' → 'get used to eating').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Most international students need a few weeks to adjust to the new timetable.
items.why: adjust to + ot — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: It took me months to get used to eat dinner so early.
items.fix: It took me months to get used to eating dinner so early.
items.why: get used to dagi 'to' — predlog, undan keyin fe'l -ing shaklda keladi.

items.s: Different values can give rise to serious misunderstandings.
items.why: give rise to + ot = sabab bo'lmoq — to'g'ri.

items.s: The university gave me some useful informations about visas.
items.fix: The university gave me some useful information about visas.
items.why: information sanalmaydi — ko'plik -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: She felt homesick during her first winter in Canada.
items.why: feel homesick — to'g'ri birikma (homesick — sifat).

items.s: My enthusiasm to the course disappeared after the first exam.
items.fix: My enthusiasm for the course disappeared after the first exam.
items.why: enthusiasm for something — predlog 'for' bo'ladi.

items.s: People in this country value their privacy very highly.
items.why: privacy sanalmaydi; value something highly — to'g'ri.

items.s: The number of international students have doubled since 2015.
items.fix: The number of international students has doubled since 2015.
items.why: Ega — 'The number' (birlik), shuning uchun 'has'.

items.s: Many newcomers suffer from culture shock in their first term.
items.why: suffer from + ot — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: Some students become withdrawn and avoid to go to lectures.
items.fix: Some students become withdrawn and avoid going to lectures.
items.why: avoid dan keyin fe'l faqat -ing shaklda keladi: avoid going.

items.s: Employers value cross-cultural skills more than ever.
items.why: cross-cultural — sifat, defis bilan yoziladi; gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Adaptation to a new culture takes time and patient.
items.fix: Adaptation to a new culture takes time and patience.
items.why: 'time' kabi ot kerak: patient (sifat) → patience (ot).

1.title: Board Game: T/F/NG, tables and culture shock
1.stage: Workbook matnidan keyin, Practice 1 dan oldin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
1.goal: T/F/NG va jadval to'ldirish qoidalarini og'zaki takrorlash, paraphrase qilish va chet elda yashash mavzusida 20–30 soniya gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: qoidani aytadi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar varag'idan tekshiradi. Paraphrase'da ma'no bir xil bo'lsa, boshqa so'zlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki to'liq bo'lmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: What do T, F and NG stand for?
squares.a: TRUE, FALSE, NOT GIVEN

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'feel homesick'
squares.a: e.g. miss your home and family

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: what is the hardest thing about living abroad?
squares.a: e.g. For me, it is being far from my family and friends.

squares.t: T/F/NG: when is the answer TRUE?
squares.a: When the text agrees with the statement (often in other words).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a newcomer'
squares.a: someone who has just arrived

squares.t: Say the opposite: familiar
squares.a: unfamiliar / strange / new

squares.t: T/F/NG: when is the answer FALSE?
squares.a: When the text says the opposite of the statement.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'compulsory'
squares.a: obligatory / required / something you must do

squares.t: Name one Uzbek custom that may surprise a foreign guest.
squares.a: e.g. Guests are always offered tea and bread first.

squares.t: T/F/NG: when is the answer NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: When the text gives no information about the claim.

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Can you write 'the local customs'?
squares.a: No — it is three words; write 'local customs'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the initial stage'
squares.a: the first stage / the beginning

squares.t: Gap: 'In stage 2, students often feel ___.' Which word type fits?
squares.a: an adjective, e.g. irritable / homesick / frustrated

squares.t: Give a newcomer to your city two pieces of advice.
squares.a: e.g. Buy a metro card. Join a club to meet people.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'more than half of the students'
squares.a: the majority of the students / most students

squares.t: Why not reread the whole text for every question?
squares.a: It wastes time; the table title and keywords show where to look.

squares.t: Text and statement share the word 'teachers'. Is the answer TRUE?
squares.a: Not necessarily — the meaning must match, not just the word.

squares.t: Explain 'reverse culture shock' in your own words.
squares.a: the problems people feel when they return home after living abroad

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lose interest'
squares.a: e.g. your enthusiasm fades / you are no longer enthusiastic

squares.t: Part 3: Is it better to study abroad or at home? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Abroad — you become independent, although it is expensive.

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'Some students never feel homesick.' Claim: 'All students get homesick.'
squares.a: FALSE — the text contradicts 'all'.

squares.t: T/F/NG? Text: 'The course costs £200.' Claim: 'The course is good value.'
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the price is given, but not whether it is good value.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'It took her a long time to adjust.'
squares.a: e.g. She needed a lot of time to get used to it.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how can universities support foreign students?
squares.a: e.g. welcome events, buddy schemes, counsellors, language classes

1.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: culture shock words
1.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin — paraphrase'ni tayyorlash (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Mavzu so'zlarini IELTS uslubidagi paraphrase bilan ulash (homesick = miss your home and family) — T/F/NG'da so'zni emas, ma'noni solishtirish ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har bir so'z faqat bitta paraphrase'ga mos keladi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('feel homesick' means 'miss your home and family'). Ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; bonus +1: istalgan 3 so'z bilan gap tuzish.

pairs: the ability to live without help
keeping your personal life to yourself

1.title: Taboo: culture shock and studying abroad
1.stage: Kirish bosqichida mavzuga isinish uchun yoki Xulosa va vazifa oldidan (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Madaniyat shoki va chet elda o'qish so'zlarini (homesick, newcomer, custom, withdrawn…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
O'zbekcha gapirish va so'zni harflab aytish mumkin emas; sinonim, qarama-qarshi ma'no va misol mumkin.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has lived away from home
1.stage: Practice 1 va Practice 2 orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Yangi joyga moslashish va chet elda yashash mavzusida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you…?) va javobni kengaytirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever felt homesick?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Where? How did you feel?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytadi. Ustoz savollarni javoblar kaliti bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has lived away from home for more than a month.
items.q: Have you ever lived away from home for more than a month?

items.t: …has been to a country where people speak another language.
items.q: Have you ever been to a country where people speak another language?

items.t: …would like to study at a university abroad.
items.q: Would you like to study at a university abroad?

items.t: …has felt homesick at a summer camp or on a trip.
items.q: Have you ever felt homesick at a summer camp or on a trip?

items.t: …has tried a foreign dish that he/she didn't enjoy.
items.q: Have you ever tried a foreign dish that you didn't enjoy?

items.t: …knows someone who works or studies overseas.
items.q: Do you know anyone who works or studies overseas?

items.t: …has moved to a new school or a new city.
items.q: Have you ever moved to a new school or a new city?

items.t: …has shown a foreign visitor around his/her city.
items.q: Have you ever shown a foreign visitor around your city?

items.t: …finds it hard to adjust to a new timetable.
items.q: Do you find it hard to adjust to a new timetable?

items.t: …has taken part in an international exchange or online project.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in an international exchange or online project?

items.t: …can name three customs that surprise foreigners in Uzbekistan.
items.q: Can you name three customs that surprise foreigners in Uzbekistan?

items.t: …would rather live with a host family than in a student residence.
items.q: Would you rather live with a host family than in a student residence?

1.title: Speaking cards: living and studying abroad
1.stage: Dars oxirida, Xulosa va vazifadan oldin — IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Chet elda o'qish va madaniyat shoki bo'yicha Part 1 (qisqa) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) javoblari; darsdagi so'zlarni (adjust to, homesick, custom, independence) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Part 1 savoliga 2–3 gap, Part 3 savoliga kamida 4 gap bilan javob beriladi (fikr + sabab + misol).
Tinglovchi darsdagi so'zlarni sanaydi (adjust to, homesick, custom, independence, support…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 juftlikni sinf oldida tinglaydi.

cards: Part 1: Have you ever stayed in another city for a long time? How did you feel at first?
Part 1: What would you miss most about Uzbekistan if you studied abroad?
Part 1: Do you prefer to travel alone or with your family? Why?
Part 1: What customs in your country might surprise a foreign visitor?
Part 1: How do you usually feel when you start at a new school or course?
Part 1: Would you like to study abroad in the future? Where and why?
Part 1: How do you keep in touch with friends and relatives who live far away?
Part 3: Why do some students find it hard to adjust to life in a new country?
Part 3: Is culture shock always a bad thing? Can it help people grow?
Part 3: What can universities do to support international students?
Part 3: Is it better for young people to live with a host family or in a student residence?
Part 3: How has the internet changed the experience of living abroad?
Part 3: Why do some people feel strange when they return home after years abroad?
Part 3: Should governments pay for talented students to study abroad? Why or why not?

1.title: Sentence Race: statements about culture shock
1.stage: Practice 2 dan keyin yoki Xulosa va vazifa oldidan tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
1.goal: T/F/NG va jadval qoidalari hamda madaniyat shoki haqidagi gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda tuzish; tuzilgan gapni paraphrase qilish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapni boshqa so'zlar bilan paraphrase qilib aytsa (ma'no o'zgarmasligi kerak).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Culture shock usually begins after the first few weeks abroad.
FALSE means that the passage says the opposite.
Copy the words exactly as they appear in the passage.
Many newcomers find it hard to adjust to local customs.
Homesickness often fades by the end of the first year.
Differences in values can give rise to misunderstandings.
Always check the word limit before writing an answer.
The table title tells you which paragraphs to read.
Returning home can be more upsetting than going abroad.
A counsellor can help students who feel homesick.

1.title: Quiz Board: T/F/NG, tables and culture shock
1.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
1.goal: T/F/NG va jadval to'ldirish qoidalari, paraphrase, madaniyat shoki so'zlari va gapirishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' savollarida 30 soniya beriladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: The text says the same thing in other words. Which answer?
The text says the opposite of the statement. Which answer?
The text says nothing about the claim. Which answer?
Can you change the spelling or form of a word from the text?
qs.a: No — copy it exactly as it appears.

qs.q: Name two things to check before you copy a table answer.
qs.a: e.g. word limit, spelling, singular/plural, word type

qs.q: most students = the … of students
compulsory = …
get used to = ad… to (two answers)
cause = give … to
not easy to notice = s… (6 letters)
Missing your home and family = feeling …
Someone who has just arrived in a new place
A traditional way of behaving in a culture
Easily annoyed, often because of stress or tiredness (i…)
The shock some people feel when they return home after years abroad
Say one thing you would miss about home if you lived abroad.
qs.a: e.g. I would miss my mum's plov.

qs.q: Name two customs from your country.
qs.a: e.g. greeting elders first; offering guests tea

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'Most students feel lonely at first.'
qs.a: e.g. The majority of students feel isolated in the beginning.

qs.q: Explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN.
qs.a: FALSE: the text contradicts it; NOT GIVEN: no information.

qs.q: Talk for 30 seconds: the stages of culture shock.

2.title: Grammar Auction: forms, clubs and city life
2.stage: Tahlil bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida, xatolar daftari bilan (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
2.goal: Klubga yozilish va shahar hayoti mavzusidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni topish: join (predlogsiz), for/since, a/an, sanalmaydigan otlar (litter), recommend sth to sb, facilities.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Artikl, predlog va ko'plik -s ni diqqat bilan tekshiring.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'join to the club' → 'join the club').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I'm from Uzbekistan, so my nationality is Uzbek.
items.why: Mamlakat — Uzbekistan, millat — Uzbek: to'g'ri.

items.s: My sister works as a economist in a bank.
items.fix: My sister works as an economist in a bank.
items.why: Unli tovush oldidan 'an' keladi: an economist.

items.s: I'd like to join to the international social club.
items.fix: I'd like to join the international social club.
items.why: join dan keyin 'to' ishlatilmaydi: join the club.

items.s: How do you spell your surname, please?
items.why: Harflashni so'rashning to'g'ri shakli.

items.s: Public transport in our city is cheap and reliable.
items.why: public transport sanalmaydi — 'is' bilan to'g'ri.

items.s: I have been a member of the club since two years.
items.fix: I have been a member of the club for two years.
items.why: Davomiylik — 'for', boshlanish nuqtasi — 'since'.

items.s: The gym has excellent facility for students.
items.fix: The gym has excellent facilities for students.
items.why: Bu ma'noda 'facilities' — ko'plikda ishlatiladi.

items.s: He is here on a six-month contract.
items.why: on a contract; 'six-month' sifat vazifasida -s olmaydi.

items.s: There is too much litters in the park near my house.
items.fix: There is too much litter in the park near my house.
items.why: litter sanalmaydi — ko'plik -s olmaydi.

items.s: The club meets every second Thursday, which means once a fortnight.
items.why: every second Thursday = har ikki haftada bir (once a fortnight).

items.s: A friend recommended me this club.
items.fix: A friend recommended this club to me.
items.why: recommend something to somebody; 'recommend me something' — xato.

items.s: It took me a few weeks to settle in and mix in with local people.
items.why: settle in, mix in with — to'g'ri iboralar.

2.title: Board Game: Section 1 — spelling, numbers, traps
2.stage: Workbook audiosidan keyin, Jony Academy mashqidan oldin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
materials: Har o'yinchiga qog'oz va ruchka (harflash va raqamlarni yozib tekshirish uchun)
2.goal: Section 1 ko'nikmalari: harflash, raqamlarni aytish (oh, double), nationality va occupation, tuzoqlar, MCQ paraphrase va klub/shahar mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi.
Harflash va raqam kataklarida o'ng tomondagi o'yinchi eshitganini qog'ozga yozadi; to'g'ri yozilsa, ikkalasi ham +1 katak oldinga yuradi.
Guruhdan bittasi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar varag'idan tekshiradi. Paraphrase'da ma'no bir xil bo'lsa, boshqa so'zlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Spell your surname letter by letter.
squares.a: e.g. K-A-R-I-M-O-V

squares.t: What does 'oh' mean in a phone number?
squares.a: zero (0)

squares.t: What is the difference between 'nationality' and 'country'?
squares.a: Country: Uzbekistan; nationality: Uzbek.

squares.t: Tell your partner your occupation or the job you want.
squares.a: e.g. I'm a student, but I want to be an engineer.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'once every two weeks'
squares.a: every other week / every second week / fortnightly

squares.t: Say this phone number aloud: 0773 155 400
squares.a: oh-double seven-three, one-double five, four-double oh

squares.t: How do you say 13 and 30? Where is the stress?
squares.a: thirTEEN (stress at the end), THIRty (stress at the start)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'at the moment'
squares.a: currently / now / at present

squares.t: Name four things a membership form usually asks for.
squares.a: e.g. name, address, phone number, occupation, date of birth

squares.t: Limit: ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. Write '25' or 'twenty-five'?
squares.a: 25 — both are accepted, but figures avoid spelling mistakes.

squares.t: Ask your partner 3 questions to fill in a club form.
squares.a: e.g. What's your first name? How do you spell it? What's your postcode?

squares.t: Why must you listen to the end before writing?
squares.a: Speakers often correct themselves; the first answer may be a trap.

squares.t: Say the date 03/05 in British English (two ways).
squares.a: the third of May / May the third

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the most frequent activity'
squares.a: the thing they do most often / the usual activity

squares.t: Speaking Part 1: Are you a member of any club or team?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, I'm in a chess club; we meet every Saturday.

squares.t: MCQ: all three options are often heard. How do you choose?
squares.a: Pick the one that matches the question's condition, e.g. NOW.

squares.t: Gap 'Nationality: ___'. You hear: 'I'm Kazakh, but I live in Tashkent.'
squares.a: Kazakh — a nationality, not a city

squares.t: Trap: 'I used to swim, but now I play tennis.' Which sport now?
squares.a: tennis — 'used to' is about the past

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Public transport is good enough.'
squares.a: Public transport is adequate / satisfactory.

squares.t: 'My flat is number 14 — no, sorry, 40.' What do you write?
squares.a: 40 — the speaker corrects the first number.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the main purpose of the club'
squares.a: the club's main aim / what the club is mainly for

squares.t: Part 3: What facilities should every city have for young people?
squares.a: e.g. sports centres, libraries and cheap public transport

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'I'm too new here to have an opinion.'
squares.a: e.g. I haven't lived here long enough to form a view.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how would you help a newcomer settle in?
squares.a: e.g. show them around, explain public transport, introduce friends

2.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: what you hear ↔ what you read
2.stage: Section 1 kombinatsiyasi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqi bilan birga (12 daqiqa)
2.goal: Audioda eshitiladigan so'z va iboralarni savoldagi paraphrase bilan ulash (every second Thursday = once every two weeks) — forma va MCQ'da paraphrase'ni tanish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora (audioda eshitiladigan) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Har bir ibora faqat bitta paraphrase'ga mos keladi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('currently means at the moment'). Ustoz tekshiradi.

3.title: Grammar Auction: writing about organic food
3.stage: Savol turlari juftligi tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
3.goal: Organik oziq-ovqat mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: so'z shakli (nutritious, misleading), predlog (compensate for), ega-kesim mosligi, ortiqcha 'more', sanalmaydigan ot (labour).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bular organik oziq-ovqat haqidagi matn yoki insho gaplari). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: very nutrition → very nutritious, compensate the lack → compensate for the lack).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Organic farmers use natural fertilisers instead of man-made chemicals.
items.why: instead of + ot — to'g'ri; fertilisers (Britancha imlo).

items.s: Lentils are cheap and very nutrition.
items.fix: Lentils are cheap and very nutritious.
items.why: Sifat kerak: nutrition (ot) → nutritious (sifat).

items.s: Organic methods often produce lower yields than conventional ones.
items.why: produce lower yields — to'g'ri birikma; ones = methods.

items.s: Traces of pesticide was found in the apples.
items.fix: Traces of pesticide were found in the apples.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (traces) → were found.

items.s: Organic food is not always more healthier than ordinary food.
items.fix: Organic food is not always healthier than ordinary food.
items.why: healthy → healthier; 'more' ortiqcha (ikki marta taqqoslash).

items.s: Strict laws regulate the use of pesticides in Europe.
items.why: regulate + the use of — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: Extra vitamins cannot compensate the lack of fresh food.
items.fix: Extra vitamins cannot compensate for the lack of fresh food.
items.why: compensate FOR — bu ma'noda predlogsiz ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: Many people are more afraid of man-made chemicals than natural toxins.
items.why: afraid of — to'g'ri predlog; more afraid … than.

items.s: The information on the label was misleaded.
items.fix: The information on the label was misleading.
items.why: Sifat: misleading (chalg'ituvchi); 'misleaded' shakli yo'q.

items.s: Some studies contradict the idea that organic food is more nutritious.
items.why: contradict + the idea that … — to'g'ri.

items.s: Organic farms need more labours than conventional farms.
items.fix: Organic farms need more labour than conventional farms.
items.why: labour (ish kuchi) — sanalmaydigan ot: -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: More and more consumers check where their vegetables come from.
items.why: consumers … check (ko'plik); where + ega + fe'l tartibi to'g'ri.

3.title: Board Game: headings, TWO letters and food

3.goal: Matching headings va TWO letters strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash, mavzu so'zlarini paraphrase qilish va oziq-ovqat haqida Speaking Part 1/3 uslubida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.

squares.a: e.g. damaging / dangerous / bad for you

squares.t: In this topic, what is the opposite of 'conventional farming'?
squares.a: organic farming

squares.t: There are 9 headings and 7 paragraphs. How many headings are extra?

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'crop rotation'.
squares.a: growing different crops in the same field in turn

squares.t: Name three things farmers put on their crops.
squares.a: e.g. fertiliser, pesticides, water

squares.t: TWO letters: how many options are there, and how many do you choose?
squares.a: Usually five options (A–E); you choose two.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The results contradict earlier studies.'
squares.a: e.g. The findings go against previous research.

squares.t: What is the 'detail trap' in matching headings?
squares.a: A heading shares a word with one detail, but not the main idea.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: what did you have for breakfast today?
squares.a: e.g. I had bread, qaymoq and green tea…

squares.a: produce (e.g. fresh produce)

squares.a: e.g. 'D — pesticides harm health'

squares.a: The first is a heading (main idea); the second is a detail.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Organic food is not affordable for everyone.'
squares.a: e.g. Organic food is too expensive for some people.

squares.t: TWO letters: an option says the OPPOSITE of the text. Choose it?
squares.a: No — the idea is reversed, so the option is wrong.

squares.t: Is a traditional Uzbek diet healthy? Give two reasons.
squares.a: e.g. Partly: lots of fresh fruit, but also a lot of bread and oil.

squares.t: Explain 'go back to basics' with an example about food.
squares.a: e.g. cooking simple meals from fresh ingredients again

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Organic farming is less efficient.'
squares.a: e.g. It produces less food from the same amount of land.

squares.t: Two headings seem to fit one paragraph. What do you do?
squares.a: Pencil in both, move on, and decide at the end from the headings left.

squares.t: Speak for 30 seconds: should governments regulate food additives?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because some additives may be harmful to children…

4.title: Grammar Auction: healthy workplace and directions

4.goal: Section 2 dagi (gid, rahbar) gaplarda tipik xatolarni topish: joy predloglari (at the roundabout, on your right, behind), balanced diet, advice (sanalmaydi), recommend + -ing.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (bular Section 2 da gid yoki rahbar aytadigan gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: in the roundabout → at the roundabout, behind of → behind).

items.s: The staff car park is opposite the main entrance.
items.why: opposite + joy (predlogsiz): opposite the main entrance.

items.s: Go straight on in the roundabout.
items.fix: Go straight on at the roundabout.
items.why: Aylanma yo'l, chorraha, svetofor — 'at': at the roundabout.

items.s: The tennis courts are just beyond the car park.

items.s: Nurses should take regular breaks during a night shift.

items.s: Shift workers often find it difficult to eat a balance diet.
items.fix: Shift workers often find it difficult to eat a balanced diet.

items.s: The medical room is directly behind of the reception desk.
items.fix: The medical room is directly behind the reception desk.
items.why: behind dan keyin 'of' qo'yilmaydi (in front of dan farqli).

items.s: Wash your hands regularly to stop germs from spreading.
items.why: stop + ot + from + -ing — to'g'ri; germs (ko'plik).

items.s: Take the second turning on the left, and the café is in your right.
items.fix: Take the second turning on the left, and the café is on your right.
items.why: Tomon: on your right / on the left ('in' emas).

items.why: from … until … — vaqt oralig'i to'g'ri berilgan.

items.why: advice — sanalmaydigan ot: -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.fix: I recommend joining the cycling initiative.

4.title: Board Game: Section 2 maps, choices and health

4.goal: Section 2 strategiyasi (MCQ shart so'zi, xaritani oldindan o'qish), yo'nalish iboralari, paraphrase va ish joyida sog'lom turmush mavzusida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: strategiya savoliga javob beradi, iborani tushuntiradi, yo'l ko'rsatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Yo'l ko'rsatish kataklarida qo'l bilan ko'rsatish mumkin emas — faqat so'z bilan (opposite, beyond, behind, on your left…).
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi; javob noto'g'ri yoki chala bo'lsa, o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Topgan o'quvchi so'zni xatosiz harflab aytsa (q-u-e-s-t-i-o-n-n-a-i-r-e) — yana +1 ball: Listeningda imlo xatosi ball olib ketadi.

4.title: Find someone who… takes a break every hour
4.stage: Student's Book Track 5–6 tekshirilgandan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
4.goal: Sog'lom turmush, o'qish/ish odatlari va yo'l topish haqida Do you…? / Have you (ever)…? / Can you…? savollarini tuzish va javobni tinglab aniq yozib olish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you take a break every hour when you study?).
'Yes' degan o'quvchining ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How often? Where? Why?). Javobdan bitta aniq ma'lumotni (vaqt, joy, son) yozib oladi.
Yo'l ko'rsatish qatorida 'Yes' degan o'quvchi yo'lni haqiqatan aytib berishi kerak (opposite, past, on the left…).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni aytib beradi.

rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: YNNG qoidasi, paraphrase, so'z shakli yoki 20–30 soniyalik gapirish.
'Y/N/NG?' kataklarida o'yinchi javobni va isbotini aytadi: qaysi so'z yozuvchining fikrini ko'rsatadi (doubt, in my view, hard to explain).
Guruh javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda javoblar varag'i bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN: facts or the writer's opinions?
squares.a: The writer's opinions and claims.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'learn a language'.
squares.a: e.g. acquire / pick up / master a language

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how did you learn your first English words?
squares.a: e.g. From cartoons and songs when I was about seven.

squares.t: Say the noun: acquire → ?
squares.a: acquisition

squares.t: Summary with a word list: do you write a word or a letter?
squares.a: A letter from the list (e.g. B, F).

squares.t: Say the adjective: fluency → ?
squares.a: fluent

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'very quickly'.
squares.a: e.g. very rapidly / at great speed / in no time

squares.t: 8 options for 5 gaps: how many options are extra?
squares.a: Three.

squares.t: What is the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: NO: the writer says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: the writer gives no view.

squares.t: Explain 'jargon' and give an example.
squares.a: Special words of one profession, e.g. doctors' medical terms.

squares.t: Do children learn languages faster than adults? Why? (30 s)
squares.a: e.g. Adults are faster at first, but children often reach a higher level.

squares.t: Gap: 'skills such as ___' — what type of word is missing?
squares.a: A noun / noun phrase naming a skill, e.g. reading.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the writer disagrees with this idea'.
squares.a: e.g. The writer rejects / doubts / questions this idea.

squares.t: 'I doubt texting harms spelling.' → Texting harms spelling. Y/N/NG?
squares.a: NO — the writer doubts it (says the opposite).

squares.t: Three question types in one passage: what is your first step?
squares.a: A map: skim all three groups and find the part of the text each covers.

squares.t: Use 'albeit' in a sentence about learning English.
squares.a: e.g. My speaking is improving, albeit slowly.

squares.t: An MCQ option repeats words from the text. Is it correct?
squares.a: Not always — check the meaning; the same words can be a trap.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'it is a matter for debate'.
squares.a: e.g. It is controversial / People disagree about it.

squares.t: Why do people move their hands when they speak? (30 s)
squares.a: e.g. Gestures help us think and find words, not only help listeners.

squares.t: Passage 3: how many minutes, and how do you split them?
squares.a: 20: map 2, YNNG 5–6, summary 5–6, MCQ 6–7.

squares.t: 'The rule is easy to use but hard to explain.' → It is easy to explain. Y/N/NG?
squares.a: NO — the writer says it is hard to explain.

squares.t: MCQ: 'the writer's purpose in paragraph 7' — what do you look for?
squares.a: The function of the whole paragraph, not one detail.

squares.t: Does texting harm young people's writing? Give your view (30 s).
squares.a: e.g. In my view, no — most teenagers switch to a formal style in essays.

squares.t: Comprehensive or comprehensible? Explain the difference.
squares.a: Comprehensive = covers everything; comprehensible = easy to understand.

5.title: Dominoes: language and communication paraphrases
5.stage: Sinf mashqidan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin — paraphrase isitish (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Til o'rganish va muloqot mavzusidagi ibora ↔ IELTS uslubidagi paraphrase juftliklarini topish (summary va YNNG dagi asosiy ko'nikma): imitate, gradual, jargon, ambiguity, give way to, get the message across.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ibora qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi paraphrase bilan bir xil ma'noda — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni davom ettiring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Har ulanishda juftlik ovoz chiqarib aytiladi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Qo'shimcha +1 ball: guruh 3 ta paraphrase'ni o'z gapida ishlatadi.

pairs: children copy the sounds they hear
it remains a matter for debate
a sentence with two possible meanings
a new stage takes the place of the old one
one stage gives way to the next
moving your hands while you talk
someone who grew up speaking English
a very high level of skill in a language
an idea that researchers set out to test
a brain that is not fully developed
writing formally in exams, casually in chats
make your meaning clear to others

5.title: Taboo: learning languages and communication
5.stage: Kirish bosqichida, til o'rganish mavzusiga isitish (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Til o'rganish va muloqot so'zlarini (fluency, jargon, ambiguity, hypothesis, gesture…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

5.title: Find someone who… has talked to a native speaker
5.stage: Student's Book matni tekshirilgandan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Til o'rganish va muloqot tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Can you…?) va javobni boshqa so'zlar bilan qayta aytish (paraphrase).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever read a whole book in English?). Zamon to'g'ri tanlanishi kerak.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Which one? Did it help you?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni paraphrase bilan aytadi (masalan: Aziz once chatted with someone whose first language is English).

items.t: …learned his/her first English words from cartoons or songs.
items.q: Did you learn your first English words from cartoons or songs?

items.t: …can say 'thank you' in more than four languages.
items.q: Can you say 'thank you' in more than four languages?

items.t: …has taught a younger relative some English words.
items.q: Have you ever taught a younger relative any English words?

items.t: …uses abbreviations like 'gr8' or 'u' in text messages.
items.q: Do you use abbreviations like 'gr8' or 'u' in text messages?

items.t: …thinks texting has made his/her spelling worse.
items.q: Do you think texting has made your spelling worse?

items.t: …uses a lot of gestures when speaking.
items.q: Do you use a lot of gestures when you speak?

items.t: …has read a whole book in English.
items.q: Have you ever read a whole book in English?

items.t: …has had a conversation with a native speaker of English.
items.q: Have you ever had a conversation with a native speaker of English?

items.t: …knows what his/her first word was as a baby.
items.q: Do you know what your first word was as a baby?

items.t: …is learning a third language at the moment.
items.q: Are you learning a third language at the moment?

items.t: …believes adults can learn a language as well as children.
items.q: Do you believe adults can learn a language as well as children?

items.t: …has been misunderstood because of a word with two meanings.
items.q: Have you ever been misunderstood because of a word with two meanings?

5.title: Speaking cards: languages, texting and communication
5.stage: Practice 2 (texting) tahlilidan keyin gapirish, Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Til o'rganish, muloqot va yozuv uslubi haqida Part 1/3 savollariga fikr + sabab + misol bilan javob berish; javob asosida YES/NO/NOT GIVEN gapi tuzish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol ('In my view…', 'I doubt that…' kabi fikr iboralari bilan).
Tinglovchi darsdagi so'zlarni sanaydi (fluency, native speaker, jargon, albeit, a matter for debate…): har biri +1 ball.
Keyin tinglovchi javob haqida 3 ta gap aytadi: biri YES, biri NO, biri NOT GIVEN bo'lishi kerak. Sherigi qaysi biri ekanini topadi; to'g'ri bo'lsa ikkalasiga +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How did you start learning English? Who or what helped you most?
Is it easier for children or for adults to learn a new language? Why?
Which is hardest for you in English: speaking, writing, listening or reading?
Do you use your hands a lot when you speak? Why do you think people do this?
How often do you send text messages? Do you use abbreviations?
Some people say texting ruins young people's writing. Do you agree?
Is it important to speak a foreign language like a native speaker? Why / why not?
Why do some professionals, such as doctors or lawyers, use so much jargon?
What is the best way to become fluent in a foreign language?
Should schools in Uzbekistan start teaching English earlier? At what age?
How has the internet changed the way people communicate?
Do you prefer to explain things in writing or face to face? Why?
Is it acceptable to write very informal emails to teachers? Why / why not?
Do you think one day everyone will speak the same language? Why / why not?
Which language would you like to learn next, and why?

5.title: Sentence Race: writers' views and paraphrased claims
5.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: Yozuvchi fikrini bildiruvchi va paraphrase qilingan gaplarda (In my view…, remains a matter for debate, The writer believes…, Some critics claim…) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish; fikr va faktni ajratish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf gap boshini, nuqta — oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball. Jamoa gap yozuvchining FIKRImi yoki FAKTmi ekanini to'g'ri aytsa — yana +1.
Jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The writer believes that gestures help speakers to think.
In my view, texting has not harmed teenagers' spelling.
Whether adults can reach native-like fluency remains a matter for debate.
Most babies say their first word at around twelve months.
Children acquire their first language in a fixed sequence of stages.
Adults make faster progress than children in the early stages.
The writer rejects the idea that texting ruins spelling.
Good writers try to avoid ambiguity in their essays.
Some critics claim that texting damages the way teenagers write.

5.title: Quiz Board: YES/NO/NOT GIVEN, summaries and language
5.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars kirishida (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
5.goal: YNNG, summary (so'zlar ro'yxati) va MCQ qoidalarini, paraphrase va til o'rganish so'zlarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi (YNNG savollarida isbot so'zini ham aytadi).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart. 'Paraphrase it' va 'Say it!' da kalit — namuna: ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: In YES / NO / NOT GIVEN, whose ideas are tested?
Summary with a word list: what do you write on the answer sheet?
qs.a: The letter of the option (e.g. C)

qs.q: 5 gaps and 8 options in the list. How many options will you NOT use?
Text: 'Adults can reach a high level.' Statement: Adults learn faster than children. Y, N or NG?
qs.a: NOT GIVEN — speed is not mentioned

qs.q: An MCQ option uses exactly the same words as the text. Why be careful?
qs.a: It may be a trap: same words, different meaning

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'copy' (sounds, words).
Paraphrase: 'little by little'.
Paraphrase: 'people disagree about it'.
qs.a: It is a matter for debate / debatable / controversial

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'make your meaning clear to people'.
Paraphrase with 'albeit': 'Her English improved, but slowly.'
A person who has spoken a language since birth.
Special words used by one profession.
A movement of the hands that shows meaning.
When a word or sentence has more than one meaning.
Complete the adjective meaning 'easy to understand': compre…
Say one way you learn new English words.
qs.a: e.g. I watch films with English subtitles.

qs.q: Give your opinion about texting, starting 'In my view, …'.
qs.a: e.g. In my view, texting doesn't ruin spelling.

qs.q: Make a sentence with 'fluent' or 'fluently'.
qs.a: e.g. I want to speak English fluently one day.

qs.q: Name three things that help a small child learn to speak.
qs.a: e.g. hearing speech, imitating, talking with parents

qs.q: Explain the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN in 20 seconds.
qs.a: NO = writer says the opposite; NG = no view given

6.title: Grammar Auction: assignments, lectures and presentations
6.stage: Section 3 qoidalari tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: O'qish (assignment, lecture, dissertation) mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: sanalmaydigan ot (advice), do/make research, passive (be backed up), ran over, weaknesses are, discuss + predlogsiz.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni avval ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (Section 3 dagidek talaba va tutor gaplari), keyin doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: useful advices → useful advice, discussed about → discussed).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The assignment is due next Monday, so we need to start today.
items.why: be due + vaqt — to'g'ri (topshirish muddati).

items.s: Our tutor gave us a lot of useful advices on the presentation.
items.fix: Our tutor gave us a lot of useful advice on the presentation.
items.why: advice — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: The talk on body language went down well with first-year students.
items.why: go down well with sb — yaxshi qabul qilinmoq; went (o'tgan zamon).

items.s: We need to make some research before writing the dissertation.
items.fix: We need to do some research before writing the dissertation.
items.why: Birikma: DO research (make research emas).

items.s: Each student has to complete a self-assessment form after the talk.
items.why: complete a form — to'g'ri birikma; has to (ega birlikda).

items.s: Every assertion in your essay needs to be back up by evidence.
items.fix: Every assertion in your essay needs to be backed up by evidence.
items.why: Majhul nisbat: be + V3 → be backed up.

items.s: Yesterday's rehearsal run over by ten minutes, so we cut the last section.
items.fix: Yesterday's rehearsal ran over by ten minutes, so we cut the last section.
items.why: O'tgan zamon: run → ran (run over = vaqtdan oshmoq).

items.s: Peer evaluation helps students notice weaknesses they might have missed.
items.why: help + sb + fe'l (to'siz) — to'g'ri; might have missed.

items.s: My main weakness are intonation and rhythm.
items.fix: My main weaknesses are intonation and rhythm.
items.why: Ikki narsa sanalgan → ko'plik: weaknesses are.

items.s: The tutor asked Dilnoza to justify her choice of extract.
items.why: ask sb to do sth; justify a choice — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: She discussed about her findings with her tutor.
items.fix: She discussed her findings with her tutor.
items.why: discuss — predlogsiz fe'l; 'about' ortiqcha.

items.s: It took us two evenings to put the slides together.
items.why: It took sb + vaqt + to do; put together — tayyorlamoq.

6.title: Board Game: Section 3 strategies and study talk
6.stage: Workbook Track 4 tekshirilgandan keyin, Jony Academy mashqidan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: Section 3 strategiyalari (TWO letters, matching, short answer so'z chegarasi, rad etilgan variant), matching variantlarini paraphrase qilish va o'qish mavzusida gapirishni og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: Section 3 qoidasi, variantni paraphrase qilish, so'z yoki 20–30 soniyalik gapirish.
Paraphrase kataklarida variant audioda qanday ESHITILISHI mumkinligini aytadi (masalan: popular → it went down well).
Guruh javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda javoblar varag'i bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Who usually speaks in Section 3?
squares.a: Two or three people, e.g. students and a tutor, on an academic topic.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The talk was popular.'
squares.a: e.g. It went down well / Everyone enjoyed it.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: your hardest assignment ever.
squares.a: e.g. A history essay — I left it until the last night.

squares.t: Choose TWO letters: how many of the five options are usually mentioned?
squares.a: Almost all of them — three are traps.

squares.t: Say the verb: justification → ?
squares.a: justify

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The essay was slow to write.'
squares.a: e.g. It took me ages to finish / I spent days on it.

squares.t: Matching: 6 options, 4 questions. How many options are extra?
squares.a: Two.

squares.t: Name three words that often signal a change of opinion.
squares.a: e.g. but, though, whereas, actually, however

squares.t: Group project or working alone: which do you prefer? Why?
squares.a: e.g. A group — we share ideas, but it's harder to organise.

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'a video camera' acceptable?
squares.a: No — three words. Write 'video camera'.

squares.t: Explain 'peer evaluation' in one sentence.
squares.a: Classmates assess each other's work.

squares.t: 'We thought about interviews, but chose a survey.' Which method?
squares.a: A survey (interviews were rejected).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The examples are relevant.'
squares.a: e.g. They're closely connected to your topic.

squares.t: Describe a good presentation you have seen (30 seconds).
squares.a: e.g. It was short, well organised and had clear slides.

squares.t: TWO letters: does the order of your two answers matter?
squares.a: No — each letter is a separate mark; any order is fine.

squares.t: Say the phrasal verb: 'go past the time limit'.
squares.a: run over (time)

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'well structured'.
squares.a: e.g. clearly organised / logically sequenced

squares.t: Feedback from a tutor or from classmates: which is more useful?
squares.a: e.g. A tutor knows more, but classmates notice what the audience feels.

squares.t: A student says one thing, the tutor corrects it. Which is the answer?
squares.a: The final, agreed idea — usually the tutor's correction.

squares.t: Use 'back up' in a sentence about an essay.
squares.a: e.g. You must back up your ideas with examples.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The talk was repetitive.'
squares.a: e.g. It kept saying the same things again and again.

squares.t: How do you use the preparation time for three question types?
squares.a: Split it: stem key ideas, matching options, the word limit.

squares.t: Should every university student write a dissertation? Why? (30 s)
squares.a: e.g. Yes — it builds research skills, though it takes a lot of time.

squares.t: Explain the difference between 'intonation' and 'rhythm'.
squares.a: Intonation = rise and fall of the voice; rhythm = pattern of stressed syllables.

6.goal: O'qish va taqdimot so'zlarini (assignment, dissertation, tutor, peer evaluation, intonation…) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntirish — Section 3 dagi paraphrase'ga tayyorgarlik.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
