6.title: Find someone who… has given a presentation in English
6.stage: Student's Book Track 10–11 tekshirilgandan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: O'qish tajribasi (taqdimot, topshiriq, so'rovnoma, baholash) haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…?) va javobdagi asosiy fikrni ajratib eshitish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever missed a deadline for an assignment?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What happened? How did it go?); javobdan 2 so'zli qisqa izoh yozadi — short answer mashqi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has given a presentation in English.
items.q: Have you ever given a presentation in English?

items.t: …has missed a deadline for an assignment.
items.q: Have you ever missed a deadline for an assignment?

items.t: …has recorded his/her own voice to check pronunciation.
items.q: Have you ever recorded your own voice to check your pronunciation?

items.t: …prefers group projects to working alone.
items.q: Do you prefer group projects to working alone?

items.t: …has filled in an online questionnaire this month.
items.q: Have you filled in an online questionnaire this month?

items.t: …gets nervous before speaking in front of the class.
items.q: Do you get nervous before speaking in front of the class?

items.t: …has attended a lecture at a university.
items.q: Have you ever attended a lecture at a university?

items.t: …usually finishes assignments the night before they are due.
items.q: Do you usually finish assignments the night before they are due?

items.t: …has marked a classmate's work.
items.q: Have you ever marked a classmate's work?

items.t: …wants to study for a master's degree abroad.
items.q: Do you want to study for a master's degree abroad?

items.t: …has asked a teacher for feedback on a piece of writing.
items.q: Have you ever asked a teacher for feedback on a piece of writing?

items.t: …has changed a project topic after talking to a teacher.
items.q: Have you ever changed a project topic after talking to a teacher?

6.title: Speaking cards: lectures, assignments and feedback
6.stage: Skript bilan tahlildan keyin gapirish, Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: O'qish, taqdimot va baholash haqida Part 1/3 savollariga javob berish; javobda fikrni o'zgartirish (Actually…, but…) va rad etish iboralarini ishlatish — Section 3 dagi fikr almashishini his qilish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida bitta variantni rad etadi: 'I thought about…, but…' yoki 'Actually, …'.
Tinglovchi darsdagi so'zlarni sanaydi (assignment, feedback, go down well, put together, back up…): har biri +1 ball.
Keyin tinglovchi TWO letters mashqidagidek sherigi TANLAGAN ikki narsani aytadi (rad etilganini emas). Sherigi tasdiqlasa, tinglovchiga +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy giving presentations? Why / why not?
What makes a lecture interesting rather than dull?
Do you prefer to work on assignments alone or with other students? Why?
How do you usually prepare for a presentation?
Is it useful for students to assess each other's work? Why / why not?
What is your main weakness as a learner, and how are you working on it?
Should universities record lectures and put them online? Why?
How important is your teacher's feedback for you? Give an example.
Do you usually finish your homework early or at the last minute?
What problems can happen when students collaborate on a project?
Is it better to learn from a lecture or from a textbook? Why?
Why do many people feel nervous when they speak in public?
Should students be allowed to choose the topics of their assignments?
How will online learning change universities in the future?

6.title: Sentence Race: tutor and student talk
6.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: Section 3 dagi tipik gaplarda (variantni rad etish, fikr o'zgarishi, tutor bahosi: but, actually, backed up, run over) so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish va gapdagi asosiy fikrni ajratish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf gap boshini, nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi — oxirini ko'rsatadi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball. Jamoa gapda nima TANLANGAN yoki RAD ETILGANINI ham aytsa — yana +1.
Jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi. Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: We thought about interviews, but a questionnaire is more practical.
The lecture on rhythm was much shorter than the other two.
Your conclusions need to be backed up by recent research.
The tutor found the second part of the talk more convincing.
If we run over by ten minutes, we will drop the last section.
Actually, I think the second option would work much better.
It took me two whole evenings to put the slides together.
Most students found the talk on gestures entertaining.
Could you look at our slides before the rehearsal on Friday?
Peer evaluation helps students to notice their own weaknesses.

6.title: Quiz Board: Section 3, paraphrases and study words
6.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars kirishida (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
6.goal: Section 3 qoidalari (TWO letters, matching, short answer), matching variantlarini paraphrase qilish va o'qish mavzusidagi so'zlarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Heard it as… 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Heard it as…' va 'Say it!' bo'limlarida 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javob namuna — ma'nosi to'g'ri boshqa variant ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many speakers are usually in Section 3?
qs.a: Two or three (e.g. students and a tutor)

qs.q: Choose TWO letters: how many marks is each letter worth?
Matching: options A–F for four questions. How many options are extra?
'We looked at a video, but decided on a podcast.' What will they make?
NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'the tutor's office' acceptable?
qs.a: No — three words; 'tutor's office' is fine

qs.q: Option: 'The audience liked it.' What might the speaker say?
qs.a: e.g. It went down well with everyone.

qs.q: Option: 'It was quick to prepare.' Paraphrase it.
qs.a: e.g. It didn't take long to put together.

qs.q: Option: 'The ideas were clearly organised.' Paraphrase it.
qs.a: e.g. It was logically sequenced / easy to follow.

qs.q: Option: 'The reading list needs updating.' Paraphrase it.
qs.a: e.g. Many of the articles are too old now.

qs.q: Option: 'The tutor doubts the method.' What might the tutor say?
qs.a: e.g. I'm not convinced this method will work.

qs.q: A piece of work a student must complete for a course.
A long piece of research written at the end of a degree.
Classmates judging each other's work.
The rise and fall of your voice when you speak.
Phrasal verb: to go past the time limit.
Name two things that make a presentation good.
qs.a: e.g. clear slides and good timing

qs.q: Reject an idea politely: 'We thought about …, but …'.
qs.a: e.g. We thought about a video, but it was too long.

qs.q: Give feedback on a talk: one positive and one negative point.
qs.a: e.g. Your slides were clear, but you spoke too fast.

qs.q: Make a sentence with 'back up'.
qs.a: e.g. Back up your claims with evidence.

qs.q: In 20 seconds, explain how you prepare for Section 3.
qs.a: e.g. Split the time: stem key ideas, options, word limit.

7.title: Grammar Auction: new media and online science
7.stage: Workbook tekshiruvidan keyin yoki Practice 2 tahlilida (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
7.goal: Yangi media mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 nomzodining tipik xatolarini (sanalmaydigan ot, passiv, most/most of, so'z turkumi, predlog, V3) topish va tuzatish; transform, recruit, distract, keep track of so'zlarini to'g'ri ishlatish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar internet, ijtimoiy tarmoq va onlayn ilm-fan haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'attention — sanalmaydigan ot') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The internet has transformed the way scientists share their results.
items.why: transform the way … — to'g'ri birikma; Present Perfect hozirgi natijani ko'rsatadi.

items.s: Social networks attract a lot of attentions from teenagers.
items.fix: Social networks attract a lot of attention from teenagers.
items.why: attention — sanalmaydigan ot, -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: The project recruited thousands of volunteers to count birds in their gardens.
items.why: recruit + kishilar + to + fe'l — to'g'ri tuzilma.

items.s: Experts review every paper before it publishes in the journal.
items.fix: Experts review every paper before it is published in the journal.
items.why: Maqola o'zini o'zi nashr qilmaydi — passiv kerak: is published.

items.s: Many readers left comments in response to the article.
items.why: leave a comment — to'g'ri birikma; in response to — javoban.

items.s: A survey showed that most of teenagers use social media every day.
items.fix: A survey showed that most teenagers use social media every day.
items.why: Umumiy ma'noda most + ot; 'most of' dan keyin the/my kabi aniqlovchi kerak.

items.s: The collaborate between the two universities lasted five years.
items.fix: The collaboration between the two universities lasted five years.
items.why: the … between — ot kerak: collaboration (collaborate — fe'l).

items.s: Some experts claim that deep reading is giving way to skimming.
items.why: give way to — o'rnini bo'shatmoq; davom etayotgan jarayon (Present Continuous).

items.s: Many people are addicted with their smartphones.
items.fix: Many people are addicted to their smartphones.
items.why: Doimiy birikma: addicted TO; 'with' ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: It is hard to keep track of all the comments on a popular video.
items.why: keep track of — kuzatib bormoq; to'g'ri ishlatilgan.

items.s: Online shopping has became a global phenomenon.
items.fix: Online shopping has become a global phenomenon.
items.why: has + V3: become (became — V2).

items.s: Notifications distract students when they are trying to concentrate.
items.why: distract + kishi — to'g'ri; 'distract to' emas.

7.title: Board Game: T/F/NG, notes and short answers
7.stage: Workbook matni tekshirilgandan keyin, Practice 1 oldidan strategiya takrori (20 daqiqa) yoki keyingi dars boshida
7.goal: Uch savol turi strategiyasini (FALSE va NOT GIVEN farqi, notes sarlavhasi, bo'shliq turi, savol so'zi → javob turi, so'z chegarasi) og'zaki takrorlash, paraphrase qilish va yangi media haqida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: T/F/NG, note completion yoki short answer qoidasini inglizcha tushuntiradi, paraphrase aytadi yoki mavzu bo'yicha gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz bergan kalit varag'i bilan tekshiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida boshqa to'g'ri variantlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida vaqtni o'ngdagi o'yinchi o'lchaydi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: What do T, F and NG stand for?
squares.a: TRUE, FALSE, NOT GIVEN

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'famous'
squares.a: well-known / celebrated

squares.t: Say one way you use the internet every day.
squares.a: e.g. I watch video lessons on YouTube every evening.

squares.t: Do T/F/NG questions follow the order of the text?
squares.a: Yes — they come in the same order as the information in the text.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'work together'
squares.a: collaborate / cooperate / join forces

squares.t: Text: 'Sales fell.' Statement: 'Sales rose.' T, F or NG?
squares.a: FALSE — the text says the opposite.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'amateur'
squares.a: non-professional / hobbyist / a member of the public

squares.t: Explain the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN.
squares.a: FALSE — the text contradicts it; NOT GIVEN — the text neither confirms nor contradicts it.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: how has the internet changed studying?
squares.a: e.g. We can find lessons, dictionaries and practice tests online for free…

squares.t: Short answer: 'Whose…?' What type of answer do you need?
squares.a: A person or a group of people, e.g. bloggers.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a big increase'
squares.a: a sharp rise / significant growth

squares.t: Text: 'He wrote a book.' Statement: 'His book became a bestseller.' T, F or NG?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the text says nothing about sales.

squares.t: Why should you read the heading of the notes first?
squares.a: It shows which part / paragraph of the text the notes come from.

squares.t: Notes: 'Most ___ are posted in the evening.' What word type fits?
squares.a: A plural noun (after 'Most', before 'are'), e.g. comments / videos.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'most young people'
squares.a: the majority of young people / most teenagers

squares.t: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS: is 'online science projects' OK?
squares.a: No — it is three words, so it gets 0 marks.

squares.t: Give two advantages of online communities.
squares.a: e.g. People share knowledge quickly and meet others with the same interests.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'transform'
squares.a: change completely / revolutionise

squares.t: Short answer: 'Which publication…?' What do you look for?
squares.a: A name — of a journal, newspaper or magazine.

squares.t: TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER: is '2,000 volunteers' OK?
squares.a: Yes — a number + one word.

squares.t: How long should you stay on one difficult question?
squares.a: About 2 minutes at most — then move on and come back later.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'has a harmful effect on'
squares.a: damages / harms / is bad for

squares.t: Should a short answer repeat words from the question? Why?
squares.a: No — write only the new information; extra words can break the word limit.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: does social media make our reading superficial?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — many people only skim headlines, but we can also find deep articles…

7.title: Dominoes: question wording ↔ text paraphrase
7.stage: 'Sinf mashqi'dan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin: paraphrase isitish (12 daqiqa)
7.goal: Savoldagi so'z va matndagi paraphrase juftliklarini tanish (a rapid increase = a sharp rise, reliable = can be trusted) — T/F/NG va note completion'da javobni topishning asosiy ko'nikmasi.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z — savoldagi ifoda; o'quvchilar matnda uning o'rnida keladigan paraphrase'ni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan topib ulaydi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('a rapid increase = a sharp rise'); ustoz kalit bilan tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; qo'shimcha +1: istalgan juftlik bilan internet haqida bitta gap.

7.title: Taboo: new media and online science
7.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin: yangi media so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
7.goal: Dars lug'atini (publish, amateur, journal, review, survey, incentive, anonymous, phenomenon, superficial…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib; oxirida har jamoa topilgan 2 so'z bilan gap tuzadi.

7.title: Find someone who… has taken part in an online survey
7.stage: Student's Book matni va Workbook orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
7.goal: Yangi media tajribalari (onlayn so'rovnoma, podcast, digital detox, izoh yozish, onlayn kurs) haqida Present Perfect va Present Simple bilan to'g'ri savol tuzish va suhbatni davom ettirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you taken part in an online survey this month?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What was it about? How often do you do it?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has taken part in an online survey this month.
items.q: Have you taken part in an online survey this month?

items.t: …has left a comment under a YouTube video this week.
items.q: Have you left a comment under a YouTube video this week?

items.t: …listens to podcasts while travelling.
items.q: Do you listen to podcasts while you are travelling?

items.t: …has tried a digital detox for at least one day.
items.q: Have you ever tried a digital detox for at least one day?

items.t: …turns off notifications when studying.
items.q: Do you turn off notifications when you study?

items.t: …reads the news on Telegram channels.
items.q: Do you read the news on Telegram channels?

items.t: …has published something online (a blog, a video or a post).
items.q: Have you ever published anything online, like a blog or a video?

items.t: …has taken an online course this year.
items.q: Have you taken an online course this year?

items.t: …checks whether a news story is true before sharing it.
items.q: Do you check whether a news story is true before you share it?

items.t: …gets distracted by their phone while doing homework.
items.q: Do you get distracted by your phone while you are doing homework?

items.t: …has read a Wikipedia article in English.
items.q: Have you ever read a Wikipedia article in English?

items.t: …follows a scientist or a science blogger online.
items.q: Do you follow a scientist or a science blogger online?

7.title: Speaking cards: the internet, science and online life
7.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
7.goal: Internet, ilm-fan va onlayn jamiyat mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga kengaytirilgan javob berish (fikr + sabab + misol); dars lug'atini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: shaxsiy (Part 1) savollarga 20–30 soniya, umumiy (Part 3) savollarga 40 soniya — fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner darsdagi so'zlardan (transform, distract, collaboration, superficial, anonymous…) nechtasi to'g'ri ishlatilganini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How often do you use the internet, and what do you mainly use it for?
Do you prefer to get your news from websites, TV or social media? Why?
Have you ever written a comment online? What was it about?
Do you think you spend too much time on your phone? Why or why not?
Which app could you not live without? Why?
Do you listen to podcasts? What kind do you like?
How has the internet changed the way young people study in Uzbekistan?
Should ordinary people be able to take part in scientific research online? Why?
Why do some people trust information online without checking it?
Are online friendships as valuable as face-to-face friendships?
Some people say the internet makes our reading more superficial. Do you agree?
Should schools teach students how to check whether online information is reliable?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of anonymous comments online?
Will printed newspapers and journals disappear in the future? Why or why not?

7.title: Sentence Race: reading strategy and new media
7.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
7.goal: T/F/NG, note completion va short answer strategiyasi haqidagi gaplarni hamda yangi media mavzusidagi gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish; strategiyani yana bir bor eslash.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Gap strategiya haqida bo'lsa, jamoa uni o'zbekcha izohlaydi — +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: TFNG questions follow the same order as the text.
Choose NOT GIVEN if the passage does not say whether the statement is true.
The heading of the notes shows you which paragraph to read.
Never write more words than the instructions allow.
Short-answer questions tell you what type of word to look for.
Social networks have transformed the way people share news.
Constant notifications make it difficult to concentrate on reading.
Peer review means that experts check a paper before publication.
Do not spend more than two minutes on one question.
The internet has made it easier for amateurs to publish their work.

7.title: Quiz Board: T/F/NG, notes and short answers
7.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida yoki takror darsida: uch savol turini takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
7.goal: Uch savol turi qoidalari, paraphrase, dars lug'ati (amateur, survey, journal, anonymous, incentive) va mavzu bo'yicha gapirishni jamoaviy o'yin orqali takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Paraphrase it' va 'Say it!' savollarida kalitdagi misoldan boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What does FALSE mean in a T/F/NG task?
qs.a: The text contradicts the statement (says the opposite).

qs.q: Text: 'The app has 2 million users.' Statement: 'The app is free.' T, F or NG?
Before you read the passage, what should you do with all three question groups?
qs.a: Skim them (about 2 min) and map which part of the text each covers.

qs.q: Notes: 'the rapid ___ of podcasts'. What word type fits the gap?
Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '250 young readers' OK?
Paraphrase: 'on the internet'
Paraphrase: 'researchers'
Paraphrase: 'many people took part'
qs.a: e.g. many people participated / there were many participants

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'a small proportion of users'
qs.a: a minority of users / a few users

qs.q: Paraphrase the sentence: 'The Web changed science completely.'
qs.a: e.g. The Web transformed / revolutionised science.

qs.q: The opposite of a professional: someone who does it as a hobby.
A set of questions that many people answer to give their opinions.
qs.a: a survey / a questionnaire / a poll

qs.q: A serious magazine that publishes scientific research.
Written by someone whose name is not known.
A reason or reward that encourages you to do something (starts with 'in-').
Name three types of new media.
Say one sentence with the verb 'distract'.
qs.a: e.g. My phone distracts me when I study.

qs.q: Give one advantage of reading the news online.
qs.a: e.g. It is fast, free and updated all the time.

qs.q: In 20 seconds: why do students often confuse NOT GIVEN with FALSE?
qs.a: e.g. The text mentions the topic, but not the exact claim.

qs.q: Say a fact about your phone use, then a FALSE version of it.
qs.a: e.g. I use it 5 hours a day. → I hardly ever use my phone.

8.title: Grammar Auction: articles, blogs and news
8.stage: 'Skript bilan qayta tinglash'dan keyin: so'z turi va ko'plik xatolari (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
8.goal: Jurnalistika va blog mavzusidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni (ega-kesim mosligi, sanalmaydigan ot, sifat/ravish, a/an, doimiy ibora) topish — Section 4 bo'shliqlarida ham aynan shu grammatika tekshiriladi.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (gaplar maqola yozish, bloglar va yangiliklar haqida). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'figures — ko'plik, are') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: A good headline should be short and eye-catching.
items.why: should + be + sifatlar — to'g'ri; eye-catching — ko'zni tortadigan.

items.s: Always check that the figures in your article is correct.
items.fix: Always check that the figures in your article are correct.
items.why: Ega — 'the figures' (ko'plik), 'article' emas: are.

items.s: Many bloggers earn money from advertising on their websites.
items.why: earn money from + ot / -ing — to'g'ri.

items.s: The website gets most of its income from advertisings.
items.fix: The website gets most of its income from advertising.
items.why: advertising — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: Make sure every fact in the report is accurately.
items.fix: Make sure every fact in the report is accurate.
items.why: be dan keyin sifat kerak: accurate (accurately — ravish).

items.s: The newest posts on a blog usually appear at the top.
items.why: the newest — orttirma daraja; usually + fe'l — to'g'ri tartib.

items.s: He was in the right place in the right time to film the event.
items.fix: He was in the right place at the right time to film the event.
items.why: Doimiy ibora: in the right place AT the right time.

items.s: Short paragraphs help to hold the reader's interest.
items.why: hold someone's interest — to'g'ri birikma; help (to) + fe'l.

items.s: An amateur journalist don't need a lot of expensive equipment.
items.fix: An amateur journalist doesn't need a lot of expensive equipment.
items.why: Birlikdagi ega (he/she) — doesn't.

items.s: It is important to mention the source of every photo you post.
items.why: mention the source of — to'g'ri; every + birlik ot.

items.s: The online newspaper became profitable business within two years.
items.fix: The online newspaper became a profitable business within two years.
items.why: business (korxona) — sanaladigan ot, birlikda artikl kerak: a profitable business.

items.s: Reading other blogs helps you keep your own blog up to date.
items.why: help + kishi + fe'l; keep … up to date — to'g'ri.

8.title: Board Game: Section 4 — gaps, flow charts and signals
8.stage: Workbook Track 5 tekshiruvidan keyin yoki keyingi darsda Section 4 strategiyasini takrorlash (20 daqiqa)
8.goal: Section 4 strategiyasi (tayyorlanish, bo'shliq turi, signal so'zlar, tuzoq, so'z chegarasi, imlo), paraphrase va havaskor jurnalistika/bloglar haqida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'shliqqa qanday so'z turi kerakligini aytadi, paraphrase qiladi, qoidani tushuntiradi yoki mavzu bo'yicha gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz bergan kalit varag'i bilan tekshiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida boshqa to'g'ri variantlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. 'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida vaqtni o'ngdagi o'yinchi o'lchaydi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi.

squares.t: How many speakers are there in Section 4?
squares.a: One — it is a lecture or a talk on an academic topic.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'eye-catching'
squares.a: attractive / striking

squares.t: Is there a break in the middle of Section 4?
squares.a: No — so read all 10 questions before you listen.

squares.t: Name three places where amateur journalists publish their work.
squares.a: e.g. blogs, social media, online newspapers

squares.t: Gap: 'She took a ___ of the festival.' What word type?
squares.a: A singular noun (after 'a'), e.g. photo.

squares.t: Say three signal words that start a new step.
squares.a: e.g. First, Then, Next, After that, Finally

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'brief'
squares.a: short / concise

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY: is 'quotations from people' OK?
squares.a: No — write only 'quotations'.

squares.t: What is a flow chart?
squares.a: A diagram that shows the steps of a process, with arrows.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: do you read any blogs? Which ones?
squares.a: e.g. I follow a travel blog about Uzbekistan because…

squares.t: Gap: 'Bloggers earn money from ___.' What can fit?
squares.a: A noun or an -ing form, e.g. advertising.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'people involved in the story'
squares.a: people who are part of the story / people who took part

squares.t: You hear: 'Not a blog — a podcast.' Gap: 'She started a ___.'
squares.a: podcast — 'not a blog' is the trap.

squares.t: Why number the flow-chart boxes before you listen?
squares.a: To follow the order of the steps and not get lost.

squares.t: Spell 'organisation' letter by letter.
squares.a: O-R-G-A-N-I-S-A-T-I-O-N (-ization is also accepted).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'make money'
squares.a: earn money / generate income / make a profit

squares.t: Gap: 'a list of useful ___'. Singular or plural?
squares.a: A plural noun, e.g. websites / links.

squares.t: Give two tips for writing a good headline.
squares.a: e.g. Keep it short and make it eye-catching.

squares.t: What does 'bang up to date' mean?
squares.a: completely modern / containing the latest information

squares.t: You wrote 'fact', but the answer is 'facts'. Is it correct?
squares.a: No — a missing -s makes the answer wrong.

squares.t: The speaker says 'And finally…'. Which flow-chart box are you in?
squares.a: The last box — the final step.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'check the accuracy of the figures'
squares.a: make sure the numbers are correct

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: should bloggers check facts like journalists?
squares.a: e.g. Yes, because readers trust them and false news spreads fast…

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how would you check a news story before sharing it?
squares.a: e.g. First I would check the source, then the date, then other websites…

8.title: Dominoes: journalism words ↔ paraphrases
8.stage: 'Sinf mashqi' bosqichida, Track 15 oldidan: ma'ruzadagi paraphrase'larga tayyorlanish (12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Jurnalistika so'zlari va ularning paraphrase'larini (brief = short, figures = numbers and statistics) tanish — Section 4 da ma'ruzachi savoldagi so'zni boshqacha aytadi.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'z — savol varag'idagi so'z; o'quvchilar ma'ruzachi aytishi mumkin bo'lgan paraphrase'ni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan topib ulaydi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('brief = short'); ustoz kalit bilan tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; qo'shimcha +1: istalgan juftlik bilan blog haqida bitta gap.

pairs: the title of a news story

8.title: Taboo: amateur journalism and blogging
8.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' savolidan keyin: jurnalistika va blog so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
8.goal: Dars lug'atini (headline, quotation, figures, source, advertising, chronological, contribute, tag…) inglizcha ta'rif va misol bilan tushuntirish — Section 4 paraphrase'lariga tayyorgarlik.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib; topgan jamoa so'zni harflab aytsa (imlo!) — +1 bonus.

8.title: Find someone who… has written an article
8.stage: Student's Book va Workbook tinglashlari orasida harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa)
8.goal: Maqola yozish, blog yuritish, yangiliklar va ingliz tilida ma'ruza tinglash tajribasi haqida Present Perfect va Present Simple bilan savol tuzish va suhbatlashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever written an article for a school website?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What was it about? When did you do it?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has written an article for a school or university website.
items.q: Have you ever written an article for a school or university website?

items.t: …has a blog or their own YouTube or Telegram channel.
items.q: Do you have a blog or your own YouTube or Telegram channel?

items.t: …has shared a news story that later turned out to be false.
items.q: Have you ever shared a news story that later turned out to be false?

items.t: …has filmed an interesting event on their phone.
items.q: Have you ever filmed an interesting event on your phone?

items.t: …usually reads only the headlines, not the full articles.
items.q: Do you usually read only the headlines, not the full articles?

items.t: …has listened to a lecture in English online.
items.q: Have you ever listened to a lecture in English online?

items.t: …takes notes while listening to lectures.
items.q: Do you take notes while you listen to lectures?

items.t: …follows a local news channel about their city.
items.q: Do you follow a local news channel about your city?

items.t: …has posted a photo with hashtags this week.
items.q: Have you posted a photo with hashtags this week?

items.t: …would like to work as a journalist.
items.q: Would you like to work as a journalist?

items.t: …checks the date of a story before sharing it.
items.q: Do you check the date of a story before you share it?

items.t: …knows someone who earns money from online advertising.
items.q: Do you know anyone who earns money from online advertising?

8.title: Speaking cards: news, blogs and citizen journalism
8.stage: Jony Academy mashqidan keyin, 'Xulosa' oldidan yoki keyingi dars boshida — Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa)
8.goal: Havaskor jurnalistika, bloglar va onlayn yangiliklar mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga kengaytirilgan javob berish; dars lug'atini (accurate, source, eye-catching, advertising) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: shaxsiy (Part 1) savollarga 20–30 soniya, umumiy (Part 3) savollarga 40 soniya — fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner darsdagi so'zlardan (headline, source, accurate, advertising, contribute…) nechtasi to'g'ri ishlatilganini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you read the news online or in print? Why?
What kind of blogs or channels do you follow?
Have you ever written something that many people read? Tell me about it.
What makes a headline eye-catching?
Would you like to be a journalist? Why or why not?
Do you prefer listening to a lecture or reading about a topic? Why?
What kind of local news interests people in your city?
Why do you think amateur journalism has become so popular?
Should bloggers follow the same rules as professional journalists?
How can ordinary people tell whether a news story is reliable?
Is it a good thing that many websites earn money from advertising? Why?
Why do false stories often spread faster than true ones online?
Will we still need professional journalists in 20 years? Why or why not?
What are the risks of filming and posting an event you see in the street?

8.title: Sentence Race: Section 4 tips and writing steps
8.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa)
8.goal: Section 4 strategiyasi va maqola yozish bosqichlari haqidagi gaplarni signal so'zlar (First of all, Next, Finally) bilan to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Oxirida signal so'zli uchta gapni (First of all… Next… Finally…) flow chart kabi ketma-ket qo'yib o'qigan jamoa +2 bonus oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Read all ten questions before the recording begins.
There is no break in the middle of Section 4.
Your answer must fit the grammar of the sentence.
Listen for signal words that show the next step.
A missing plural -s can cost you a mark.
First of all, decide who your readers are.
Next, check every number against a reliable source.
Finally, write a short headline that attracts attention.
Check your spelling when you transfer your answers.
The newest blog posts appear at the top of the page.

8.title: Quiz Board: Section 4 — sentence and flow-chart completion
8.stage: Keyingi darsning 'Kirish' qismida yoki takror darsida: Section 4 kombinatsiyasini takrorlash (15 daqiqa)
8.goal: Section 4 qoidalari, bo'shliq grammatikasi (so'z turi, birlik/ko'plik, a/an), jurnalistika so'zlari va mavzu bo'yicha gapirishni jamoaviy o'yin orqali takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Fill the gap 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida kalitdagi misoldan boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi; 'Topic words' javobi imlosi bilan aytilsa — +50 bonus.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: How many questions are there in Section 4?
Does the Section 4 speaker give only facts?
qs.a: No — also opinions and advice, and these can be tested too.

qs.q: ONE WORD ONLY: is 'local news' acceptable?
Can the flow-chart boxes come in a different order from the talk?
qs.a: Almost never — the chart follows the order of the talk.

qs.q: You write 'quotes / quotations' on the answer sheet. Is it correct?
qs.a: No — write only one answer; two options get no mark.

qs.q: 'Write a ___ headline.' Adjective or verb?
'Readers can ___ their own photos.' Noun or verb?
'Include several ___ from witnesses.' Singular or plural noun?
'Make sure that all the facts are ___.' Which word type?
You hear: 'not a letter but an email'. Gap: 'Readers now send an ___.'
The title of a newspaper article.
A person's exact words repeated in an article.
Numbers or statistics in a report (plural noun, starts with 'f').
Arranged in the order in which events happened.
A keyword added to a post so that people can find it.
Say a sentence with the word 'headline'.
qs.a: e.g. The headline was so eye-catching that I read the article.

qs.q: Name three kinds of local news that people in your city care about.
qs.a: e.g. traffic, new parks, prices, school events

qs.q: Give two tips for writing a good article.
qs.a: e.g. Put the key facts first; include quotations.

qs.q: In 20 seconds: why do people share false news?
qs.a: e.g. They believe it, or it makes them angry or surprised.

qs.q: Describe three steps to write a blog post. Use First, Then, Finally.
qs.a: e.g. First choose a topic, then write a draft, finally add tags.

9.title: Grammar Auction: Units 1–4 sentences
9.stage: Mockdan oldin takror yoki keyingi dars boshida — yozma javobdagi -s, predlog, so'z shakli xatolari (15 daqiqa); ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzularidagi (madaniyat shoki, sog'lom ovqat, til o'rganish, taqdimot, internet va bloglar) gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: predlog, sanalmaydigan ot, so'z turi, artikl, moslashuv.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Mockdagi kabi har so'zni — predlog, -s, artikl, fe'l shaklini — tekshiring.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'a harmful effect to' → 'a harmful effect on'). Ustoz har xatoni mockdagi 2-sabab bilan bog'laydi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Many international students find it hard to adjust to a new climate.
items.why: adjust to + ot — to'g'ri birikma (Unit 1).

items.s: My cousin is used to live on his own now.
items.fix: My cousin is used to living on his own now.
items.why: be used to dagi 'to' — predlog: undan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi.

items.s: Organic farmers do not use chemical pesticides on their crops.
items.why: Ko'plik ega va 'do not use' — moslashuv to'g'ri (Unit 2).

items.s: Eating too much sugar can have a harmful effect to your health.
items.fix: Eating too much sugar can have a harmful effect on your health.
items.why: have an effect ON something — predlog 'on' bo'ladi.

items.s: The company provides a lot of equipments for staff who want to exercise.
items.fix: The company provides a lot of equipment for staff who want to exercise.
items.why: equipment sanalmaydigan ot — ko'plik -s qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: If the passage gives no information about a statement, the answer is NOT GIVEN.
items.why: Gap ham, qoida ham to'g'ri: isbot yo'q — NOT GIVEN.

items.s: Children acquire their first language without any formal teaching.
items.why: acquire a language — to'g'ri kollokatsiya (Unit 3).

items.s: The lecture was very interested, so nobody left early.
items.fix: The lecture was very interesting, so nobody left early.
items.why: Narsa qiziqarli — -ing (interesting); odam qiziqadi — -ed (interested).

items.s: Each student have to give a ten-minute presentation.
items.fix: Each student has to give a ten-minute presentation.
items.why: each + birlik ot → fe'l ham birlikda: has.

items.s: The internet has transformed the way scientists share their findings.
items.why: Present perfect + 'the way' + gap — to'g'ri (Unit 4).

items.s: Amateur journalist with a phone can report news faster than a TV crew.
items.fix: An amateur journalist with a phone can report news faster than a TV crew.
items.why: Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldidan artikl kerak: an amateur journalist.

items.s: Before you share a story online, check that the figures in it are accurate.
items.why: figures (raqamlar) — ko'plik, 'are accurate' to'g'ri.

9.title: Board Game: Mock review — Units 1–4
9.stage: Mockdan bir dars oldin umumiy takror yoki mockdan keyingi dars boshida (20 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 savol turlari qoidalarini (T/F/NG, Y/N/NG, so'z chegarasi, TWO letters, headings, xarita), paraphrase'ni, xom ball → band jadvalini va olti xato sababini og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoida savoliga to'liq gap bilan javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 30–40 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari ustozning javoblar kaliti bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Band savollarida doskadagi xom ball — band jadvalidan, sabab savollarida 'Olti sabab' jadvalidan foydalanish mumkin.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: How many questions are there in Listening and in Reading?
squares.a: 40 in each.

squares.t: How long is the Reading test? How long for each passage?
squares.a: 60 minutes; about 20 minutes per passage.

squares.t: Spell your family name and your street name aloud.
squares.a: e.g. K-A-R-I-M-O-V (Section 1: every letter counts).

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'every second Thursday'.
squares.a: every other Thursday / once a fortnight, on a Thursday

squares.t: What is the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite. NOT GIVEN: the text says nothing about it.

squares.t: Limit: TWO WORDS. You write 'the local library'. Is it OK?
squares.a: No — three words = 0 marks. Write 'local library'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'nutritious food'.
squares.a: e.g. food that is good for your health / nourishing food

squares.t: Listening: 23 correct answers. What band is it?
Cause 2 = 'I heard it but wrote it wrongly'. Give an example.
squares.a: e.g. I heard 'two weeks' but wrote 'two week'.

squares.t: Matching headings: can you use one heading for two paragraphs?
squares.a: No — each heading fits only one paragraph; some headings are extra.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: what surprised you most in a new place?
squares.a: e.g. When I first visited Tashkent, the fast pace of life surprised me.

squares.t: Map: you are walking south and turn left. Which way are you going now?
squares.a: East.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Most people disagreed with the plan.'
squares.a: e.g. The majority of people were against the plan.

squares.t: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN: whose ideas do you check?
squares.a: The writer's views and claims — never your own opinion.

squares.t: Reading: 19 correct. What band? Did you reach the 5.5 target?
squares.a: 5.5 (19–22) — yes, the target is 19+.

squares.t: Summary with a word list: what do you write on the answer sheet?
squares.a: The letter (A, B, C…) from the list, not the word.

squares.t: 'Choose TWO letters': you write only B. What is the risk?
squares.a: You lose a mark — always write two different letters.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is organic food worth the higher price?
squares.a: e.g. I think it is, because it is grown without chemical pesticides, although…

squares.t: Cause 3 = 'I ran out of time'. What is the cure?
squares.a: The map method and time limits: about 20 minutes per passage.

squares.t: Flow chart: in what order do the answers usually come?
squares.a: In the same order as the recording or text.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Many bloggers earn money from adverts.'
squares.a: e.g. Advertising gives a lot of bloggers an income.

squares.t: Why should you never leave an answer blank?
squares.a: Wrong answers lose no marks, so a guess may earn a mark.

squares.t: Name your two weakest question types and the lesson for each.
squares.a: e.g. Matching headings — lesson 3; T/F/NG — lessons 1 and 7.

squares.t: Talk for 40 seconds: your two-week plan after the mock.
squares.a: e.g. Every day I will do one timed passage and write the evidence for each answer.

9.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: Units 1–4 words and answer types
9.stage: 'Javoblar varaqasi: Reading' bosqichidan oldin — paraphrase va FALSE / NOT GIVEN farqini eslash (12 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 so'z va iboralarini IELTS uslubidagi paraphrase bilan ulash (feel homesick = miss your family and home) hamda FALSE va NOT GIVEN ta'rifini takrorlash — mockdagi 1- va 4-sabablarning davosi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshining o'ng tomonidagi so'z yoki iborani o'qing va chap tomonida uning paraphrase'i yozilgan toshni toping.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi ('feel homesick — miss your family and home'); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: get used to a different way of life
food that is good for the body
stop work for a few minutes
once a fortnight, on a Thursday
learn another language naturally over time
someone who reports news without pay
the passage says nothing about it

9.title: Taboo: topic words from Units 1–4
9.stage: Natija tushishini kutayotganda yoki keyingi dars boshida isinish sifatida (10 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzu so'zlarini (culture shock, pesticide, canteen, fluency, dissertation, headline…) inglizcha tushuntirish — mockda kerak bo'lgan paraphrase ko'nikmasini gapirishda mashq qilish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi (ta'rif, sinonim, misol bilan paraphrase qiladi).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Jamoa so'z qaysi Unit mavzusidan ekanini ham aytsa (masalan: 'canteen — Unit 2'), yana +1 ball.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

9.title: Find someone who… has lived away from home
9.stage: Natijani ochishdan oldin harakatli tanaffus yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzulari (yangi joy, klub, ovqat, til, taqdimot, yangiliklar) va mock tajribasi bo'yicha to'g'ri savol tuzish: Have you ever…? Do you…? Did you…? Can you…?
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever lived away from home for more than a month?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (How did you feel? / Why?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollar grammatikasini kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …has lived away from home for more than a month.
items.q: Have you ever lived away from home for more than a month?

items.t: …has felt homesick on a trip or at a summer camp.
items.q: Have you ever felt homesick on a trip or at a summer camp?

items.t: …has joined a club or sports centre this year.
items.q: Have you joined a club or sports centre this year?

items.t: …buys organic fruit or vegetables.
items.q: Do you buy organic fruit or vegetables?

items.t: …skipped breakfast this morning.
items.q: Did you skip breakfast this morning?

items.t: …can give directions from school to the nearest bus stop.
items.q: Can you give directions from school to the nearest bus stop?

items.t: …has started learning a third language.
items.q: Have you started learning a third language?

items.t: …has given a presentation in English.
items.q: Have you ever given a presentation in English?

items.t: …reads a blog or follows a news channel in English.
items.q: Do you read a blog or follow a news channel in English?

items.t: …has checked a news story before sharing it.
items.q: Have you ever checked a news story before sharing it?

items.t: …finished the mock Reading with time to spare.
items.q: Did you finish the mock Reading with time to spare?

items.t: …found the mock Listening easier than the Reading.
items.q: Did you find the mock Listening easier than the Reading?

9.title: Speaking cards: Units 1–4 and exam experience
9.stage: Mockda Speaking yo'q — tahlildan keyin yoki keyingi darsda IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 mashqi (12 daqiqa)
9.goal: Unit 1–4 mavzulari (chet elda o'qish, sog'lom ovqat, til o'rganish, taqdimot, internet va yangiliklar) va mock tajribasi bo'yicha 3–4 gapli, sababli javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–40 soniya javob beradi: fikr + sabab + misol. Part 3 savollarida 'On the other hand…' bilan ikkinchi tomonni ham aytadi.
Tinglovchi javobdagi Unit 1–4 so'zlarini sanaydi (adjust, homesick, nutritious, fluency, collaborate, accurate…): har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How did you feel during the mock test? Which section was the hardest for you, and why?
What do you usually do the evening before an important exam?

What helps you more with IELTS: full mock tests or practising one question type at a time?

9.title: Sentence Race: exam rules and Units 1–4 statements
9.stage: 'Savol turi → Unit xaritasi' bosqichidan oldin qoidalarni tezkor takrorlash (8 daqiqa)
9.goal: Imtihon qoidalari (NOT GIVEN, FALSE, imlo, jarima yo'qligi, xatolarni tur bo'yicha guruhlash) va Unit 1–4 mavzusidagi paraphrase gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Ishora: nuqtali so'z — oxirda; NOT GIVEN, FALSE, Listening doim katta harf bilan yoziladi, gap boshida emas.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Qoida gapini o'zbekcha izohlab bersa — yana +1 ball.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Write NOT GIVEN when the passage gives no information.
Write FALSE when the passage says the opposite.
In Listening, a misspelt word makes the whole answer wrong.
You do not lose marks for a wrong answer.
Group your mistakes by question type to find a pattern.
It can take several months to adjust to a new culture.
Organic vegetables are grown without chemical pesticides.
Shift work makes it hard to eat a balanced diet.
Babies acquire their first language by imitating the people around them.
Amateur journalists must check that their figures are accurate.

9.title: Quiz Board: Mock 1 review — Units 1–4
9.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida umumiy takror (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
9.goal: Savol turi qoidalari, paraphrase, xom ball → band, olti xato sababi va Unit 1–4 mavzularini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Scores & causes 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. Band savollarida doskadagi xom ball — band jadvalidan foydalanish mumkin.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bilan aytiladi; ustoz mazmun va grammatikani baholaydi.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: The text says the opposite of the statement. TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN?
Which Reading question type asks about the writer's views or claims?
Summary with a word list: do you write the word or the letter?
Matching headings: can you use the same heading for two paragraphs?
qs.a: No — each heading fits only one paragraph.

qs.q: Map labelling: you are walking south and turn right. Which direction are you walking now?
Paraphrase 'every second week'.
qs.a: every two weeks / every other week / once a fortnight

qs.q: Paraphrase 'the majority of people'.
Give a synonym for 'nutritious'.
Paraphrase 'collaborate'.
Paraphrase 'give rise to'.
How many questions are there in the Listening test?
Listening: 23 correct answers. What band?
Reading: 19 correct answers. What band — and is it the 5.5 target?
You wrote 'two week', but the answer was 'two weeks'. Which cause (1–6)?
qs.a: Cause 2: I heard it but wrote it wrongly.

qs.q: You changed B to C, but B was right. Which cause, and what is the rule?
qs.a: Cause 6 — never change an answer without evidence.

qs.q: Say one thing that surprised you in the mock test.
qs.a: e.g. The Reading passages were longer than I expected.

qs.q: Explain 'culture shock' in one sentence.
qs.a: e.g. Feeling confused and anxious in a new culture.

qs.q: Give directions to the exit using 'opposite' or 'beyond'.
qs.a: e.g. Go past reception; the exit is opposite the lift.

qs.q: Give one advantage and one drawback of organic food.
qs.a: e.g. It has fewer pesticides, but it is more expensive.

qs.q: Name your two weakest question types and the unit you will go back to.
qs.a: e.g. Matching headings → Unit 2; T/F/NG → Units 1 and 4.

10.title: Grammar Auction: energy and climate sentences
10.stage: Kirish bosqichidan keyin, 'Uch tur — bitta passage' dan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani takrorga
10.goal: Qayta tiklanadigan energiya va iqlim mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 xatolarini topish: rise / raise, vulnerable to, ravish (efficiently), most / most of, olmosh va fe'l moslashuvi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato? Predlog, ko'plik, so'z turi va fe'l moslashuvini tekshiring.
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'vulnerable for' → 'vulnerable to').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Solar power has become much cheaper over the last decade.
items.why: Present perfect + 'over the last decade' — to'g'ri.

items.s: Many countries still depend on fossil fuels for most of its electricity.
items.fix: Many countries still depend on fossil fuels for most of their electricity.
items.why: countries — ko'plik, olmosh ham ko'plikda: their.

items.s: The new wind farm will generate enough electricity for 20,000 homes.
items.why: generate electricity — to'g'ri kollokatsiya.

items.s: Global temperatures are raising faster than scientists expected.
items.fix: Global temperatures are rising faster than scientists expected.
items.why: raise — nimanidir ko'tarmoq (to'ldiruvchi bilan); o'zi ko'tarilsa — rise: rising.

items.s: Scientists estimate that sea levels could rise by one metre by 2100.
items.why: estimate that + gap; rise BY (miqdor) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Coastal villages are very vulnerable for rising sea levels.
items.fix: Coastal villages are very vulnerable to rising sea levels.
items.why: vulnerable TO something — predlog 'to' bo'ladi.

items.s: One drawback of wind power is that it depends on the weather.
items.why: drawback of + ot; depend on — to'g'ri.

items.s: Offshore turbines produce electricity more efficient than turbines on land.
items.fix: Offshore turbines produce electricity more efficiently than turbines on land.
items.why: Fe'lni (produce) ravish tasvirlaydi: more efficiently.

items.s: The government offers a subsidy to families who install solar panels.
items.why: offer a subsidy to + kim; odamlar uchun 'who' — to'g'ri.

items.s: Most of experts agree that human activity is causing climate change.
items.fix: Most experts agree that human activity is causing climate change.
items.why: most + ot (most experts) yoki most of THE experts; 'most of experts' xato.

items.s: Planting trees can offset part of the carbon we produce.
items.why: offset — o'rnini qoplamoq; gap to'g'ri.

items.s: The number of electric cars in Tashkent have doubled.
items.fix: The number of electric cars in Tashkent has doubled.
items.why: the number of … — birlik ega: has doubled.

10.title: Board Game: matching, summary and green energy
10.stage: Student's Book matnidan keyin, Workbook'dan oldin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (20 daqiqa)
10.goal: Matching information, matching features va summary completion qoidalarini, ishlash navbatini, paraphrase'ni va qayta tiklanadigan energiya / iqlim mavzusida gapirishni og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoida savoliga to'liq gap bilan javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi, gap tuzadi yoki 30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari ustozning javoblar kaliti bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Qoida kataklarida o'yinchi doskadagi uch ustunga ('Summary → qaysi xatbosh?', 'Ismlar', 'Information → ma'lumot turi') qarashi mumkin.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name the three question types in today's passage.
squares.a: Matching information, matching features, summary completion.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'renewable energy'.
squares.a: e.g. clean energy from sources that do not run out

squares.t: Which of the three types usually follows the order of the text?
squares.a: Summary completion.

squares.t: Name three renewable energy sources.
squares.a: e.g. solar, wind, hydro (water), geothermal

squares.t: In what order should you do the three types today?
squares.a: Summary → matching features → matching information.

squares.t: What does 'a comparison of the costs' look like in a text?
squares.a: e.g. 'X is cheaper / more expensive than Y'.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: where have you seen solar panels in Uzbekistan?
squares.a: e.g. On new houses, street lights and schools in my town.

squares.t: What does 'You may use any letter more than once' mean?
squares.a: One option can be the answer to two or more questions.

squares.t: Matching information: 'an estimate of…'. What do you scan for?
squares.a: Numbers, amounts or calculations (e.g. 'about $3 billion').

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'fossil fuels'.
squares.a: coal, oil and (natural) gas

squares.t: Matching features: 7 names but only 4 questions. What are the extra names?
squares.a: Distractors — they appear in the text but match no statement.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'drawback'.
squares.a: e.g. The main drawback of wind farms is the noise.

squares.t: 'A suggestion for…': which words in a text signal a suggestion?
squares.a: e.g. should, ought to, need to, recommend, it would be better to

squares.t: Summary limit: TWO WORDS. You write 'the rising sea levels'. OK?
squares.a: No — four words = 0 marks. Keep only the words that fit the gap.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how does climate change affect Uzbekistan?
squares.a: e.g. Summers are hotter and rivers carry less water, so farmers suffer.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'on a large scale'.
squares.a: e.g. in very large amounts / very widely

squares.t: One paragraph mentions two organisations. How do you choose?
squares.a: Check the subject and verb: who actually did, said or estimated it?

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'vulnerable to'.
squares.a: e.g. Low coastal cities are vulnerable to flooding.

squares.t: Why do we leave matching information until last?
squares.a: Its questions are not in text order; by then you know the passage well.

squares.t: Give one word for 'damage that can never be undone'.
squares.a: irreversible (damage)

squares.t: Should schools teach children how to save energy? Why? (30 s)
squares.a: e.g. Yes — habits learnt early last a lifetime, and families pay less for power.

squares.t: Matching features: why circle every name in the text first?
squares.a: To make a map: each name + its paragraph + a 2–3-word note.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'offset'.
squares.a: e.g. Some airlines plant trees to offset their emissions.

squares.t: Passage 2 = 20 minutes. Split the time among the three types.
squares.a: e.g. summary 5, features 6, information 7, checking 2.

10.title: Paraphrase Dominoes: energy words and information types
10.stage: 'Uch tur — bitta passage' tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqi bilan birga (12 daqiqa)
10.goal: Energiya va iqlim so'zlarini paraphrase bilan ulash (fossil fuels = coal, oil and gas) va matching information'dagi ma'lumot turini (estimate, comparison, suggestion, reference) misol gapdan tanish.

Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: power from sources that never run out

the place where a wild species lives
state money to support a project

doubtful that the idea will work
fields that nobody uses any more
harm that can never be undone

a comparison of two energy sources

a reference to an earlier failure

10.title: Speaking cards: energy, climate and nature
10.stage: Dars oxirida, Xulosa va vazifadan oldin — IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa)
10.goal: Qayta tiklanadigan energiya, iqlim o'zgarishi va tabiatni asrash bo'yicha 3–4 gapli javob berish; Unit 5 so'zlarini (drawback, subsidy, vulnerable, emissions, habitat) ishlatish.

cards: Do you try to save energy at home? What do you do?

11.title: Grammar Auction: eco-holidays and volunteering
11.stage: 'Notes + table' tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
11.goal: Eko-sayohat va ko'ngillilik gaplarida Band 5–6 tipik xatolari: sanalmaydigan ot (accommodation, litter), ko'plik (fifty volunteers; species o'zgarmaydi), predlogdan keyin -ing, ega-kesim mosligi — Section 1 transferida ham ball yo'qotadi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (sayohat agentligi yoki ko'ngillilar tashkiloti suhbatidagi kabi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: fifty volunteer → fifty volunteers, a cheap accommodation → cheap accommodation).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The travel agent gave me a quote for a two-week trip to the mountains.
items.why: quote for + narsa; 'two-week' sifat bo'lib kelganda -s olmaydi.

items.s: We need to find a cheap accommodation near the reserve.
items.fix: We need to find cheap accommodation near the reserve.
items.why: accommodation (BrE) — sanalmaydigan ot: oldiga 'a' qo'yilmaydi.

items.s: The project needs at least fifty volunteer this summer.
items.fix: The project needs at least fifty volunteers this summer.
items.why: fifty dan keyin ko'plik: volunteers. Section 1 da -s tushib qolsa ham 0 ball.

items.s: You can get a 10% discount if you book three months in advance.
items.why: discount + if-gap; 'in advance' = oldindan. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Don't forget to buy travel insurance before you fly.
items.why: insurance — sanalmaydi: 'a' ham, -s ham yo'q; travel insurance — tayyor birikma.

items.s: Volunteers help to protect endangered specieses in the park.
items.fix: Volunteers help to protect endangered species in the park.
items.why: species — birlik va ko'plik shakli bir xil; -es qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: I'm interested in volunteer at a nature reserve.
items.fix: I'm interested in volunteering at a nature reserve.
items.why: Predlogdan (in) keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi: interested in volunteering.

items.s: She has worked in wildlife conservation for five years.
items.why: for + muddat bilan Present Perfect; 'work in conservation' — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: Tourists should not leave litters on the beach.
items.fix: Tourists should not leave litter on the beach.
items.why: litter — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: Bear in mind that a visa application can take up to a month.
items.why: bear in mind that + gap = 'yodda tuting'; up to a month = bir oygacha.

items.s: The volunteers stayed with a local family in a small village.
items.why: stay with + kishi (a family); stay in + joy (a village).

items.s: Eco-holidays is becoming more popular with young people.
items.fix: Eco-holidays are becoming more popular with young people.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (eco-holidays) → kesim 'are'.

11.title: Board Game: Section 1 notes and tables
11.stage: Student's Book Track 19–20 tekshirilgandan keyin, Workbook Track 6 dan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
11.goal: Notes/table completion strategiyasini og'zaki mustahkamlash: so'z chegarasi, bo'shliq turini bashorat qilish, tuzatish tuzog'i, raqam va harflarni aytish, imlo, parafraz hamda eko-sayohat mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, so'z yoki raqamni ovoz chiqarib aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdagi 'hakam' javoblar varag'idagi namunaga qarab tekshiradi; ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunli, to'liq javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Predict the answer type: 'Must bring a ___'.
squares.a: a singular noun (after 'a')

squares.a: e.g. Yes, we camped near Chimgan last summer and…

squares.a: pay before the trip / make an advance payment

squares.t: Limit: TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Is '3 wooden cabins' OK?
squares.a: Yes: two words + a number is allowed.

squares.t: Limit: ONE WORD. You write 'local family'. Is it OK?
squares.a: No: two words break the limit, so 0 marks.

squares.a: e.g. A holiday that doesn't harm nature and helps local people.

squares.t: Say this date the British way: 21/10.
squares.a: the twenty-first of October / October the twenty-first

squares.t: Tables: do speakers usually go row by row or column by column?
squares.a: Usually row by row: one option, then all its details.

squares.t: Why should you NOT copy words already given in the notes (e.g. '£')?
squares.a: They are already there, and extra words can break the word limit.

squares.a: No: write the plural 'cyclists'; a missing -s loses the mark.

squares.t: What do given cells like 'hostel' help you do in a table?
squares.a: They are signposts: they show where you are in the recording.

squares.a: e.g. I'd like to plant trees in my city because…

squares.a: oh-nine-double five, double three-two, two-double one

squares.t: Conservation vs conversation: explain the difference.
squares.a: conservation = protecting nature; conversation = talking

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'unspoilt'.
squares.a: untouched / not damaged by tourism or building

squares.a: e.g. Yes, because the money can pay for rangers and clean-ups.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

11.title: Find someone who… has volunteered

11.goal: Eko-sayohat, ko'ngillilik va tabiatni asrash bo'yicha savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Would you…? Do you…?), javobni tinglab ism va qisqa tafsilotni yozib olish — Section 1 dagi kabi.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever volunteered for a charity or community project?).
'Yes' degan odam ismini harflab aytadi (Section 1 dagi kabi); so'rovchi ismni va bitta tafsilotni (qachon? qayerda?) ikki so'zgacha yozib oladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi; ustoz 2–3 ism va tafsilotni tekshiradi (imlo va so'z chegarasi to'g'rimi?).

12.title: Grammar Auction: shopping and retail
12.stage: Practice 1 tahlilidan keyin, Practice 2 dan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Xarid va savdo mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: persuade/make dan keyingi fe'l shakli, sanaladigan ot (purchases, discounts), so'z shakli (redundant), ega-kesim mosligi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (do'kon, xaridor psixologiyasi va savdo haqidagi matn yoki insho gaplari). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?

Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: persuade customers buying → persuade customers to buy, was made redundancy → was made redundant).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Supermarkets often place sweets near the checkout to tempt children.
items.why: place + narsa + joy; 'to tempt' maqsadni bildiradi. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: Many shoppers make unplanned purchase when they are hungry.
items.fix: Many shoppers make unplanned purchases when they are hungry.
items.why: purchase — sanaladigan ot: unplanned purchases (ko'plik -s).

items.s: Slow background music can persuade customers buying more.
items.fix: Slow background music can persuade customers to buy more.
items.why: persuade + kishi + TO + fe'l: persuade customers to buy.

items.s: Own-label products are usually cheaper than branded ones.
items.why: Qiyosiy daraja: cheaper than; 'ones' = products.

items.s: The retailer's turnover rose by 12% last year.
items.why: rise by + foiz (o'sish miqdori); rose — rise ning o'tgan zamon shakli.

items.s: The smell of fresh bread makes shoppers to feel hungry.
items.fix: The smell of fresh bread makes shoppers feel hungry.
items.why: make + kishi + fe'l ('to' siz): makes shoppers feel.

items.s: Many stores put fresh fruit and vegetables near the entrance.
items.why: put + narsa + joy; fruit — sanalmaydi, vegetables — ko'plik. Gap to'g'ri.

items.s: He was made redundancy after the shop closed.
items.fix: He was made redundant after the shop closed.
items.why: be made redundant — sifat kerak; redundancy — ot, bu yerga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

items.s: The shop gives discount to its loyal customers.
items.fix: The shop gives discounts to its loyal customers.
items.why: discount — sanaladigan ot: a discount yoki discounts.

items.s: Shoplifting costs retailers millions of pounds every year.
items.why: shoplifting — sanalmaydigan ot, kesim birlikda: costs.

items.s: In many supermarkets, the bakery is located at the back of the store.
items.why: be located at the back of = '… ning orqa qismida joylashgan'. Gap to'g'ri.
