items.fix: Most shoppers don't notice the background music.
items.why: Most shoppers — ko'plik ega: doesn't emas, don't.

12.title: Board Game: diagram, T/F/NG and flow chart
12.stage: Uch savol turi tushuntirilgandan keyin yoki Student's Book matnidan so'ng mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Diagram labelling, TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN va flow chart strategiyasini og'zaki mustahkamlash: FALSE va NOT GIVEN farqi, so'z chegarasi, bo'shliqqa kerak so'z turi, parafraz hamda xarid mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, so'z yoki raqamni ovoz chiqarib aytadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruhdagi 'hakam' javoblar varag'idagi namunaga qarab tekshiradi; ochiq topshiriqlarda mazmunli, to'liq javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Name three places you can find in a supermarket.
squares.a: e.g. aisle, checkout, bakery, entrance

squares.t: What does 'aisle' mean? How do you say it?
squares.a: the path between shelves; it sounds like 'I'll' (silent s)

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: where do you usually buy food, and why?
squares.a: e.g. At the local bazaar, because it's cheaper and fresher.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'buy'.
squares.a: purchase / pay for / get

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'cheap'.
squares.a: inexpensive / low-priced / affordable

squares.t: Which answer means 'the text gives no information'?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN

squares.t: Diagram labelling: what should you read first?
squares.a: The instructions (word limit), the title and the labels already given.

squares.t: Do diagram answers always come in text order?
squares.a: No — they follow the diagram's layout, not always the text.

squares.t: Do flow-chart answers usually follow the text order?
squares.a: Yes — a process is usually described step by step.

squares.t: Explain 'impulse buying' with an example from your life.
squares.a: e.g. Buying sweets at the checkout that I didn't plan to buy.

squares.t: Predict the word type: 'a large ___ near the entrance'.
squares.a: a singular noun, e.g. display / sign

squares.t: Predict the word type: 'Goods are then ___ to the shop.'
squares.a: a past participle, e.g. delivered / sent

squares.t: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Is 'fresh fruit juice' OK?
squares.a: No — three words break the limit (0 marks).

squares.t: Statement: 'The shop opened in 2010.' Text: 'It opened in 2012.' Answer?
squares.a: FALSE — the text contradicts it.

squares.t: Statement: 'Most shoppers like the music.' Text: music is not mentioned. Answer?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — there is no information.

squares.t: What's the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite; NOT GIVEN: no information.

squares.t: Branded or own-label products: which do you buy and why?
squares.a: e.g. Own-label — they're cheaper and the quality is similar.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Shops want customers to stay inside longer.'
squares.a: e.g. Shops aim to increase customers' dwell time.

squares.t: Statement: 'All stores bake bread on site.' Text: 'about half do'. Answer?
squares.a: FALSE — 'about half' is not 'all'.

squares.t: Why are 'all', 'always' and 'never' in a statement warning signs?
squares.a: They are absolute; if the text only says 'most' or 'some', the answer is FALSE.

squares.t: Should you copy words from the text for diagram answers?
squares.a: Yes — copy them exactly, with correct spelling and plural -s.

squares.t: Give two ways shops tempt people to spend more.
squares.a: e.g. the smell of fresh bread, sweets at the checkout

squares.t: 'Music affects spending more than lighting.' The text never compares them. Answer?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN — the text makes no comparison.

squares.t: Part 3: Do supermarkets manipulate customers? Give a reason.
squares.a: e.g. Partly — layouts lead us past goods we didn't plan to buy.

12.title: Dominoes: shopping words and paraphrases
12.stage: Student's Book matni (The way the brain buys) tekshirilgandan keyin, Workbook'dan oldin (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Savdo va xarid psixologiyasi so'zlarini IELTS uslubidagi parafrazi bilan ulash (bargain, retailer, turnover, dwell time, impulse buying…) — T/F/NG va chizma savollarida kalit so'zni matndan tez topish uchun.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi so'zning parafrazi (ta'rifi) qaysi toshning chap tomonida — toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring; har ulanishda bir o'quvchi juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (masalan: 'turnover' — 'the total value of sales in a period').
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi.
To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib. Qo'shimcha: guruh 3 ta so'z bilan do'kon haqida bittadan gap tuzadi.

a company that sells products directly to shoppers
the total value of sales in a period
a passage between rows of shelves
goods sold under the shop's own name
how long a shopper stays in a store
people who keep returning to the same shop
to make someone want something they may not need
to convince someone by giving reasons
to lose your job because it is no longer needed
how easily something can be seen
to think carefully about a situation

12.title: Taboo: shops and shopping
12.stage: Sinf mashqi (do'kon so'zlari) o'rnida yoki undan keyin (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Do'kon va savdo so'zlarini (aisle, bargain, own-label product, turnover, tempt, loyal…) inglizcha tushuntirish — chizma va flow chart yorliqlarini hamda T/F/NG kalit so'zlarini tez tanish uchun.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Find someone who… has found a real bargain
12.stage: Workbook matni tekshirilgandan keyin, Practice 1 dan oldin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Xarid odatlari bo'yicha savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you usually…? Do you prefer…?) va javoblarni tinglash; bargain, refund, loyalty card, own-label kabi so'zlarni jonli ishlatish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever bargained for a lower price at a market?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What did you buy? Where?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi.

items.t: …has bought something they didn't need because it was on sale.
items.q: Have you ever bought something you didn't need because it was on sale?

items.q: Do you usually make a shopping list before you go to the supermarket?

items.q: Do you prefer shopping at a bazaar to shopping in a supermarket?

items.q: Do you have a loyalty card for a shop or café?

items.q: Have you ever returned something to a shop and got a refund?

items.q: Do you buy own-label products to save money?

items.q: Have you ever bargained for a lower price at a market?

items.q: Have you ever spent more than you planned in a shopping centre?

items.t: …shops online more often than in real shops.
items.q: Do you shop online more often than in real shops?

items.t: …has had a part-time job in a shop or at a market.
items.q: Have you ever had a part-time job in a shop or at a market?

items.t: …keeps the receipts for everything they buy.
items.q: Do you keep the receipts for everything you buy?

items.t: …has bought a snack at the checkout without planning to.
items.q: Have you ever bought a snack at the checkout without planning to?

12.title: Speaking cards: shops, shoppers and spending
12.stage: Kirish bosqichida ('Qaysi do'konda xarid qilasiz?') davomi, Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: Xarid, do'konlar va savdo psixologiyasi mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish; tempt, persuade, impulse buying, loyal, bargain so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi: javob + sabab + misol (Part 3 savollarida ikki tomonni ham ayting).
Tinglovchi dars so'zlarini sanaydi: har bir to'g'ri ishlatilgan so'z (bargain, tempt, loyal, impulse buying…) +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. Vaqt tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you enjoy shopping? Why or why not?
Where do you usually buy your clothes: in shops, at markets or online?
Do you usually make a shopping list? Do you stick to it?
What was the last bargain you got? Tell me about it.
Do you prefer branded products or cheaper own-label ones? Why?
How has shopping in your city changed in the last ten years?
Why do you think supermarkets put sweets near the checkout?
Is it fair for shops to use music and smells to make us spend more?

Do advertisements persuade young people to buy things they don't need?
Will ordinary shops disappear because of online shopping? Why or why not?

What would your ideal shopping centre look like?

12.title: Sentence Race: T/F/NG rules and shop layout
12.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: T/F/NG va flow chart qoidalarini hamda do'kon joylashuvi va xaridor xulqi haqidagi parafrazlangan gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf gap boshini, nuqta esa oxirini ko'rsatadi.

Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Bonus +1: jamoa gapni o'zgartirib, unga nisbatan FALSE bo'ladigan gap aytadi (masalan: 'Most customers turn right' → 'All customers turn left').
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Supermarkets place basic goods at the back of the store.
Freshly baked bread makes many customers feel hungry.
Cheaper own-label products are placed on the lowest shelves.
Write NOT GIVEN if there is no information in the text.
In a flow chart, answers come in the same order as the text.
Shoppers spend more money when the background music is slow.
Most customers tend to turn right when they enter a shop.
The retailer's turnover increased by ten per cent last year.
After the goods are checked, they are put on the shelves.
Products at eye level are more likely to be bought.

12.title: Quiz Board: diagrams, T/F/NG and shopping
12.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars kirishida (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
12.goal: T/F/NG, chizma va flow chart qoidalari, parafraz hamda do'kon va savdo so'zlarini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Rules' bo'limida javobni qisqa izohlash ham kerak (nega FALSE, nega NOT GIVEN).
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: The text says the opposite of the statement. Answer?
The text has no information about the statement. Answer?
Which usually follows the text order: a flow chart or a diagram?
In a diagram task, what should you read first?
qs.a: The instructions, the title and the labels already given

qs.q: The statement says 'all stores'; the text says 'only a few stores'. Answer?
'buy' = p___

Name two things shops do to tempt customers.
qs.a: e.g. special offers, sweets at the checkout

qs.q: Say why you like or dislike shopping centres.
qs.a: e.g. I like them because everything is in one place.

qs.q: Paraphrase: 'Prices went up last year.'
qs.a: e.g. Prices rose / increased last year.

qs.q: Explain FALSE vs NOT GIVEN to a new student.
qs.a: FALSE: the text says the opposite; NG: it says nothing.

qs.q: Persuade the class to buy own-label products (20 seconds).
qs.a: e.g. They're cheaper, and the quality is often the same.

13.title: Grammar Auction: banks, cards and machines
13.stage: Sinf mashqi (joylashuv iboralari, 'oxirgi qaror qaysi?') dan keyin, Track 1 dan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
13.goal: Bank, karta va avtomatlar mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: joylashuv predlogi (just above), birikma (in credit, savings account), so'z turi (forge), decide against + -ing, used to.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bank, karta va avtomatlar haqidagi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: just above of → just above, on credit → in credit).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The chip is on the left, just above of the card number.
items.fix: The chip is on the left, just above the card number.
items.why: above — predlog, undan keyin 'of' kelmaydi: just above the card number.

items.s: The magnetic strip runs across the back of the card.
items.why: run across the back of — to'g'ri joylashuv iborasi (orqa tomonda, butun kenglik bo'ylab).

items.s: The café used to be on the ground floor, but now it is upstairs.
items.why: used to be — o'tmishdagi joy (tuzoq); 'now' dan keyingisi — javob.

items.s: My account is on credit, so I don't pay any charges.
items.fix: My account is in credit, so I don't pay any charges.
items.why: Hisobda pul bor — 'in credit'; 'on credit' esa qarzga sotib olish degani.

items.s: Banknotes are very difficult to forgery.
items.fix: Banknotes are very difficult to forge.
items.why: difficult to + fe'l kerak: forge (fe'l), forgery (ot).

items.s: The bank logo is usually in the bottom right-hand corner.
items.why: in the bottom right-hand corner — to'g'ri: burchak ichida 'in'.

items.s: We thought about putting the cash machine outside but decided against it.
items.why: decide against + it / -ing — reja o'zgarishi iborasi, to'g'ri.

items.s: I'd like to open a saving account for my holiday money.
items.fix: I'd like to open a savings account for my holiday money.
items.why: Birikma: savings account (-s bilan), 'saving account' emas.

items.s: The bottle machines are used to be in the car park.
items.fix: The bottle machines used to be in the car park.
items.why: O'tmishdagi holat: used to be; 'are used to' — ko'nikmoq, boshqa ma'no.

items.s: Your card's expiry date is printed just above your name.
items.why: expiry date — to'g'ri birikma; just above + ot.

items.s: The bank charges are pretty steep, so we decided against to open an account.
items.fix: The bank charges are pretty steep, so we decided against opening an account.
items.why: against — predlog, undan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida: opening.

items.s: If you spend more than you have, you will go into the red.
items.why: go into the red — minusga tushmoq; 1-tur shart gap to'g'ri.

13.title: Board Game: Section 2 — matching, diagrams and money
13.stage: Workbook Track 7 tekshirilgandan keyin, Jony Academy mashqidan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
13.goal: Section 2 strategiyasini og'zaki takrorlash: matching sharti va tuzog'i, reja o'zgarishi iboralari, chizmada joylashuv so'zlari, so'z chegarasi, bank paraphrase'lari va pul haqida gapirish.

Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq savollarda mazmunli, to'g'ri gap yetarli.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki 10 soniyada aytilmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Matching: how many letters do you write for each question?
squares.a: Only one letter.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lifts'.
squares.a: elevators

squares.a: e.g. the chip, the card number, the cardholder's name

squares.a: it's free / there is no charge

squares.t: Say the position: the corner at the bottom, on the right.
squares.a: in the bottom right-hand corner

squares.a: Two letters are not used at all.

squares.t: Speaking: Do you prefer paying by card or in cash? Why?
squares.a: e.g. By card — it's faster, and I don't need any change.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'customers with money in their account'.
squares.a: customers who are in credit

squares.t: Diagram: do you start from the top of the picture or the lowest number?
squares.a: The lowest question number — the audio follows the question order.

squares.t: Spell aloud: 'signature'.
squares.a: S-I-G-N-A-T-U-R-E

squares.t: The speaker says 'used to be'. Is that the answer?
squares.a: No — it's the old place (a trap). Wait for where it is now.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'the charges are pretty steep'.
squares.a: the fees are rather high / it's quite expensive

squares.t: Say 2 phrases a speaker uses when a plan changes.
squares.a: e.g. instead / we decided against… / actually / used to

squares.t: Label: 'black ___'. You hear 'a black magnetic strip'. What do you write?
squares.a: magnetic strip — don't repeat 'black' from the label.

squares.t: Speaking: Where is the cash machine nearest to your home?
squares.a: e.g. It's inside the supermarket, next to the entrance.

squares.t: ONE OR TWO WORDS: you write 'the bank logo'. Is it OK?
squares.a: No — 'the' counts, so three words get 0 marks; write 'bank logo'.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a present when you first join the bank'.
squares.a: a free gift for new customers

squares.t: Matching trap: the speaker names five banks. How do you choose?
squares.a: Check the exact condition in the question (new / students / certain).

squares.t: Explain 'go into the red' and give an example.
squares.a: Spend more than you have: e.g. I went into the red after my holiday.

squares.t: Describe where a vending machine is in your school or college.
squares.a: e.g. It's in the corridor on the ground floor, next to the stairs.

squares.t: Name two security features of a bank card. Why do they help?
squares.a: e.g. The chip and the hologram make the card hard to forge.

squares.t: Explain the difference: 'near the campus' and 'on the campus'.
squares.a: Near = close to it; on = inside the university area.

squares.t: Speaking: Should teenagers have their own bank card? Why/why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — they learn to manage money, but with a spending limit.

squares.t: Speaking: Will cash machines disappear in the future? Why?

14.title: Grammar Auction: lies, trust and families
14.stage: Student's Book matni (The truth about lying) tekshirilgandan keyin, Workbook'dan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
14.goal: Munosabatlar mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: birikma (tell lies, a sign of), predlog (depend on), ega-kesim mosligi, so'z turi (selfish, invisible) — sentence completion'dagi so'z turi tekshiruviga tayyorlov.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (oila, do'stlik va yolg'on haqidagi gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: says lies → tells lies, depend of → depend on).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Older siblings often take a dominant role in the family.
items.why: take a dominant role — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: My brother never says lies to our parents.
items.fix: My brother never tells lies to our parents.
items.why: Birikma: tell a lie / tell lies ('say' emas).

items.s: Parents have a strong influence on their children's personalities.
items.why: have an influence ON — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: My best friend always keep her promises.
items.fix: My best friend always keeps her promises.
items.why: Ega birlikda (my best friend) → keeps (-s).

items.s: Nervous behaviour is not always a sign for lying.
items.fix: Nervous behaviour is not always a sign of lying.
items.why: Birikma: a sign OF something.

items.s: Liars tend to give fewer details than honest people.
items.why: fewer + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (details) — to'g'ri.

items.s: The youngest child is often described as spoilt and selfishness.
items.fix: The youngest child is often described as spoilt and selfish.
items.why: described as + sifat: selfish (sifat), selfishness (ot).

items.s: It takes years to build trust, but only seconds to lose it.
items.why: It takes + vaqt + to do — to'g'ri; build trust — tabiiy birikma.

items.s: Most people can depend of their family in a crisis.
items.fix: Most people can depend on their family in a crisis.
items.why: depend ON — to'g'ri predlog.

items.s: The girl finally confessed that she had eaten all the sweets.
items.why: confess that + Past Perfect — to'g'ri (oldinroq bo'lgan ish).

items.s: Middle children sometimes feel invisibly in large families.
items.fix: Middle children sometimes feel invisible in large families.
items.why: feel + sifat: invisible (ravish emas).

items.s: Her shaky voice gave away the fact that she was lying.
items.why: give away — fosh qilmoq; the fact that + gap — to'g'ri.

14.title: Board Game: headings, features and relationships
14.stage: Workbook matni (Establishing your birthrights) tekshirilgandan keyin, Practice 1 dan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
14.goal: Uch savol turi qoidalarini (headings, features, sentence completion), paraphrase, so'z turi va munosabatlar mavzusida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoida, paraphrase, bo'shliqqa so'z yoki qisqa gapirish (to'liq gap bilan).
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namuna bilan solishtiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq savollarda mazmunli, to'g'ri gap yetarli.
Javob xato bo'lsa yoki 10 soniyada aytilmasa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

squares.t: Headings: are the paragraphs in order? Are the headings in order?
squares.a: Paragraphs go A, B, C…; the list of headings is mixed.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'brothers and sisters'.
squares.a: siblings

squares.t: Sentence completion: do the answers come in text order?
squares.a: Yes, always.

squares.t: Name a reliable person in your life and say why.
squares.a: e.g. My uncle — he always keeps his promises.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'people you work with'.
squares.a: colleagues

squares.t: Features: can you use one letter more than once?
squares.a: Yes, if the instructions say so; some letters may not be used.

squares.t: ONE WORD ONLY: you write 'close friends'. Is it OK?
squares.a: No — two words get 0 marks.

squares.t: Gap: 'She has three ___.' (sibling / siblings)
squares.a: siblings — plural after 'three'.

squares.t: Speaking: Are you the eldest, middle, youngest or only child? Does it matter?
squares.a: e.g. I'm the eldest, so I feel responsible for my siblings.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'relatives'.
squares.a: family members

squares.t: Features: why underline the names in the text first?
squares.a: The statements are not in text order, so you can find the names quickly.

squares.t: Gap: 'She has a very ___ personality.' (calm / calmly)
squares.a: calm — an adjective before a noun.

squares.t: Speaking: Can you tell when a friend is lying? How?
squares.a: e.g. Sometimes — they give fewer details than usual.

squares.t: A word in a heading also appears in the paragraph. Is it the answer?
squares.a: Not necessarily — check the main idea of the whole paragraph.

squares.t: Say the opposite of 'trust' (noun).
squares.a: distrust / mistrust

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'saw each other less'.
squares.a: had less contact / met less often

squares.t: Explain the 'detail trap' in matching headings.
squares.a: One detail fits a heading, but the paragraph's main idea is different.

squares.t: Time: 20 minutes for Passage 2. About how long for six headings?
squares.a: About 8 minutes.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a tell-tale sign'.
squares.a: a clear clue / an obvious sign

squares.t: Speaking: What makes a good friend? Give two qualities.
squares.a: e.g. Being reliable and being honest.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'shrug off'.
squares.a: ignore / not let something worry you

squares.t: Explain 'nature versus nurture' in one sentence.
squares.a: It's the debate about whether our genes or our upbringing shape us more.

squares.t: Speaking: Is it ever acceptable to tell a white lie? Give an example.
squares.a: e.g. Yes — saying you love a present that you don't really like.

squares.t: Speaking: Can online friends give real support? Why/why not?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — many chat, but only a few help in a real crisis.

14.title: Dominoes: headings and paragraph summaries

15.title: Grammar Auction: talking about a study project

15.goal: Loyiha, so'rovnoma va do'stlik mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: predlog (consist of, focus on), predlogdan keyin -ing, ega-kesim mosligi, information, suggest + -ing.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bular Section 3 dagidek talabalar loyiha haqida aytadigan gaplar). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: consists from → consists of, informations → information).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Our tutor told us to narrow down the topic.
items.why: tell + kishi + to + fe'l; narrow down the topic — to'g'ri birikma.

items.s: The questionnaire consists from ten short questions.
items.fix: The questionnaire consists of ten short questions.
items.why: consist of — predlog 'of'; 'from' emas.

items.s: Every student must include a bibliography at the end of the project.
items.why: must + fe'l asosi; at the end of — to'g'ri.

items.s: Sara is very nervous about give the presentation.
items.fix: Sara is very nervous about giving the presentation.
items.why: Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi: about giving.

items.s: Our sample was too small to be representative.
items.why: too + sifat + to be — to'g'ri; sample = tanlanma.

items.s: Only thirty students has filled in the questionnaire so far.
items.fix: Only thirty students have filled in the questionnaire so far.
items.why: Ega ko'plikda (students) → have filled in.

items.s: We had to limit the scope of our study to one university.
items.why: limit the scope of … to … — to'g'ri ibora (tadqiqot doirasini cheklamoq).

items.s: I haven't decided yet what to focus.
items.fix: I haven't decided yet what to focus on.
items.why: focus on — predlog tushib qolmasin: what to focus on.

items.s: Many people make lifelong friends at university.
items.why: make friends — to'g'ri birikma; lifelong — sifat (umrbod).

items.s: We collected a lot of useful informations from the survey.
items.fix: We collected a lot of useful information from the survey.
items.why: information — sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi.

items.s: People who move abroad often lose touch with their old friends.
items.why: lose touch with — to'g'ri ibora (aloqani yo'qotmoq).

items.s: My tutor suggested me to use a pie chart.
items.fix: My tutor suggested using a pie chart.
items.why: suggest + -ing (yoki suggest that I use); 'suggest me to' xato.

15.title: Board Game: Section 3 strategies and friendship
15.stage: Workbook Track 8 tekshirilgandan keyin, Jony Academy mashqidan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Section 3 strategiyasi (MCQ o'zagi, flow chart so'z turi, signal iboralar, oxirgi kelishilgan so'z), paraphrase va loyiha/do'stlik mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: Section 3 qoidasini tushuntiradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namunaga solishtiradi; ochiq savollarda mazmunli va grammatik to'g'ri javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Who usually speaks in Listening Section 3, and about what?
squares.a: Usually two to four people (students, sometimes a tutor) discussing academic work.

squares.t: Say it another way: 'a questionnaire'.
squares.a: e.g. a survey form / a list of written questions

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about your best friend.
squares.a: e.g. My best friend is Aziz; we met at school and…

squares.t: MCQ: what should you underline before you listen?
squares.a: The key idea in the question stem, not the options.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The topic is too broad.'
squares.a: e.g. The topic is far too wide / needs narrowing down.

squares.t: What does 'That's the trouble…' tell you?
squares.a: A problem is coming — the answer usually follows.

squares.t: Flow chart: 'Interview five ___ from the club'. What kind of word is missing?
squares.a: A plural noun, e.g. members (it comes after 'five').

squares.t: Say the nouns: present / assess / define
squares.a: presentation / assessment / definition

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'lifelong friends'
squares.a: e.g. friends for life / friends you keep all your life

squares.t: A survey or interviews for a class project? Why?
squares.a: e.g. A survey — it is quicker and reaches more people.

squares.t: You hear 'a leaflet… no, a poster'. Which word do you write?
squares.a: poster — the final, agreed word.

squares.t: What is a 'bibliography'?
squares.a: A list of all the sources used in a project.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'Statistics aren't necessary.'
squares.a: e.g. Numerical data is not essential.

squares.t: Why are all three MCQ options often mentioned?
squares.a: To trap you: the wrong ones are mentioned but rejected, or refer to another person/time.

squares.t: Finish the sentence: 'Email the tutor, or better still, …'
squares.a: e.g. …go and see him in person.

squares.t: When is a sample 'representative'?
squares.a: When it is similar to the whole group being studied.

squares.t: Part 3: Is it easier to make friends at school or at work? Why?
squares.a: e.g. At school — people spend all day together and share interests.

squares.t: Limit: TWO WORDS. Can you write 'the local community'?
squares.a: No — that is three words; write 'local community'.

squares.t: Suggest a plan, starting with 'Tell you what, …'
squares.a: e.g. Tell you what, I'll message the rest of the group tonight.

squares.t: Name four stages of a research project in order.
squares.a: e.g. read sources → write questions → collect data → analyse results

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'narrow down the topic'
squares.a: e.g. limit the scope / make the topic more specific

squares.t: Part 3: Can online friendships be as strong as real-life ones?
squares.a: e.g. Partly — they can be close, but meeting in person builds trust.

squares.t: Say two signal phrases that introduce the next stage.
squares.a: e.g. 'After that…', 'The next thing is…'

squares.t: Retell today's Section 3 conversation in 30 seconds.
squares.a: e.g. Two students planned a project: first they…, after that they…

15.title: Dominoes: what you hear ↔ what you read
15.stage: Sinf mashqi (signal iboralar, flow chart bo'shliqlari) dan keyin, Track 7 dan oldin (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Section 3 da gapiruvchi aytgan fikrni savol varag'idagi paraphrase bilan tanish (Hardly anyone replied = low response rate; no names = anonymous).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: unda gapiruvchi AUDIODA aytadigan gap yozilgan. Shu gapning savol varag'idagi PARAPHRASE'i qaysi toshning chap yarmida — toping va ulang.
Yangi toshning o'ng yarmida keyingi audio gap bor — zanjirni shu tarzda davom ettiring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi (audio gap → paraphrase); ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: The topic is far too wide.
It needs to be narrowed down.
The response rate was very low.
Let's try the questions out first.
You must list everything you read.
We've been friends since we were six.
We slowly stopped seeing each other.
Our group is typical of students in general.
Show the percentages in a circle.
He's the one who marks our work.
The tutor is responsible for assessment.
Explain what the key terms mean.
Say a bit about the history first.

15.title: Taboo: projects, research and friendship
15.stage: Kirish bosqichida, loyiha va do'stlik mavzusiga isitish (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Loyiha va tadqiqot so'zlarini (tutor, assessment, questionnaire, bibliography, sample, pie chart) inglizcha ta'riflash — Section 3 dagi paraphrase'ni tanishga yordam beradi.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

15.title: Find someone who… has given a presentation in English
15.stage: Student's Book Track 7 tekshirilgandan keyin harakatli tanaffus (10 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Loyiha, taqdimot va do'stlik tajribasi haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? Do you…? Would you rather…?) va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever given a presentation in English?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? How did you feel?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va eng qiziq javobni sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarning to'g'riligini kalit bo'yicha tekshiradi.

items.t: …has given a presentation in English.
items.q: Have you ever given a presentation in English?

items.t: …has filled in an online questionnaire this month.
items.q: Have you filled in an online questionnaire this month?

items.t: …has a friend he/she has known for over ten years.
items.q: Do you have a friend you have known for over ten years?

items.t: …has worked on a group project this year.
items.q: Have you worked on a group project this year?

items.t: …would rather work alone than in a team.
items.q: Would you rather work alone than in a team?

items.t: …has made a new friend online.
items.q: Have you ever made a new friend online?

items.t: …gets nervous before speaking in public.
items.q: Do you get nervous before speaking in public?

items.t: …has used a pie chart or a graph in a project.
items.q: Have you ever used a pie chart or a graph in a project?

items.t: …is still in touch with a friend from primary school.
items.q: Are you still in touch with a friend from primary school?

items.t: …has lost touch with a close friend.
items.q: Have you ever lost touch with a close friend?

items.t: …has taken part in a survey for a research project.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a survey for a research project?

items.t: …prefers texting friends to calling them.
items.q: Do you prefer texting your friends to calling them?

15.title: Speaking cards: projects, teamwork and friendship
15.stage: Skript bilan tahlildan keyin gapirish, Speaking Part 1/3 uslubi (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Do'stlik, guruh loyihalari va tadqiqot haqida Part 1 (qisqa) va Part 3 (fikr + sabab + misol) javoblari; darsdagi so'zlarni (survey, lifelong, presentation) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Part 1 kartasiga 2–3 gap, 'Part 3' deb yozilgan kartaga kamida 4 gap bilan javob beriladi: fikr + sabab + misol.
Tinglovchi javobdagi dars so'zlarini (survey, sample, lifelong, presentation, narrow down…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Javobda 'or better still' yoki 'tell you what' to'g'ri ishlatilsa — +2 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you prefer working on projects alone or in a group? Why?
Have you ever given a presentation? How did you feel?
How did you meet your best friend?
What makes someone a good friend, in your opinion?
Do you keep in touch with your old school friends? How?
Is it easy for you to make new friends? Why or why not?
What would you like to research if you could choose any project topic?
Part 3: Why do some friendships last a lifetime while others end quickly?
Part 3: How has social media changed the way young people make friends?
Part 3: Should universities help first-year students to make friends? How?
Part 3: Are group projects a fair way to assess students? Why or why not?
Part 3: What are the advantages of surveys compared with interviews?
Part 3: Do people have fewer close friends today than in the past?
Part 3: Is it better to have many friends or just a few close ones?

15.title: Sentence Race: signal phrases and project talk
15.stage: Xulosa va vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Section 3 signal iboralari (That's the trouble, The very first thing, After that, Or better still, Tell you what) va loyiha haqidagi gaplarda so'z tartibini tuzish.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf va tinish belgilari yordam beradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi. Jamoa gapdagi signal iborani aytib bersa — yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: That's the trouble: our sample is far too small.
Our tutor said the topic was far too broad.
The very first thing we should do is agree on a topic.
After that, we need to analyse the results.
Or better still, we could ask the tutor for advice.
Tell you what, I'll email the tutor about it.
The presentation must not be longer than ten minutes.
Make sure you add a bibliography at the end of your report.
It is hard to keep in touch with school friends.
The survey will be anonymous, so nobody needs to give their name.

15.title: Quiz Board: Section 3, paraphrase and project words
15.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars kirishida (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
15.goal: Section 3 qoidalari (MCQ tuzog'i, oxirgi kelishilgan so'z, so'z chegarasi), paraphrase, loyiha so'zlari va signal iboralarni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob og'zaki, to'liq gap bilan aytiladi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What is Listening Section 3 usually about?
qs.a: An academic topic: a project, assignment or research

qs.q: In MCQ, what do you underline: the stem or the options?
qs.a: The key idea in the stem

qs.q: Speaker: 'We could meet online… or better still, face to face.' Which idea is the answer?
qs.a: face to face (the final, better idea)

qs.q: Why shouldn't you choose an option just because you heard it?
qs.a: All three are often mentioned; some are rejected or refer to others

qs.q: Limit: TWO WORDS. You hear 'the student union'. What do you write?
Paraphrase: 'a list of all the sources you used'
Paraphrase: 'friends for your whole life'
Paraphrase: 'we won't use anyone's name'
Paraphrase: 'it takes ages'
Paraphrase: 'test the questions on a few people first'
qs.a: carry out / run a pilot study

qs.q: The person who guides a student's project at university
A circle divided into parts to show percentages
One step in a process, e.g. in a flow chart
The group of people chosen to represent a larger population in a study
Phrasal verb: to make a topic smaller and more specific
Introduce a problem with 'That's the trouble…'
qs.a: e.g. That's the trouble — hardly anyone replied to our survey.

qs.q: Improve an idea with 'or better still'.
qs.a: e.g. We could email them, or better still, meet them.

qs.q: Suggest a plan starting with 'Tell you what…'
qs.a: e.g. Tell you what, I'll book a room tonight.

qs.q: Say three stages of a project with 'first / after that / finally'.
qs.a: e.g. First we read, after that we do a survey, finally we present.

qs.q: Give two reasons why an online survey can be a bad idea.
qs.a: e.g. Few people reply; the sample may not be representative.

16.title: Grammar Auction: writing about fashion and fabrics
16.stage: Sinf mashqi ('Fakt yoki fikr?', dress / clothes / cloth) dan keyin, Student's Book matnidan oldin (15 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
16.goal: Moda va mato mavzusidagi gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: clothes / cloth, so'z shakli (fragile), predlog (famous for), afford to, turg'un ibora (stand the test of time), has + V3.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi (bular moda, kiyim va restavratsiya haqidagi jurnal maqolasi yoki insho gaplari). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — tikilgan pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: warm cloths → warm clothes, famous with → famous for).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: This silk dress is too fragile to be worn again.
items.why: too + sifat + to be worn — to'g'ri; fragile = mo'rt.

items.s: She packed enough warm cloths for a week in Chimgan.
items.fix: She packed enough warm clothes for a week in Chimgan.
items.why: Kiyim-kechak — clothes; cloth(s) — mato(lar).

items.s: Denim is a durable fabric, so jeans last for years.
items.why: a durable fabric — to'g'ri birikma; durable = chidamli.

items.s: Bukhara is famous with its gold embroidery.
items.fix: Bukhara is famous for its gold embroidery.
items.why: 'Nima bilan mashhur' — famous for, 'with' emas.

items.s: Experts spent months restoring the old costume.
items.why: spend + vaqt + -ing: spent months restoring.

items.s: Some of the costumes are too fragility to put on display.
items.fix: Some of the costumes are too fragile to put on display.
items.why: too dan keyin sifat kerak: fragility (ot) → fragile.

items.s: In my view, fast fashion encourages people to throw clothes away too quickly.
items.why: encourage + kishi + to + fe'l; throw away — ajraladigan fe'l.

items.s: Most students cannot afford buying designer clothes.
items.fix: Most students cannot afford to buy designer clothes.
items.why: afford + to + fe'l: afford to buy.

items.s: Haute couture is far more expensive than ready-to-wear clothing.
items.why: far more expensive than — kuchaytirilgan taqqoslash, to'g'ri.

items.s: A well-made coat can stand the test of the time.
items.fix: A well-made coat can stand the test of time.
items.why: Turg'un ibora: stand the test of time — 'time' dan oldin artikl yo'q.

items.s: The robe is decorated with an intricate gold pattern.
items.why: decorated with — to'g'ri predlog; unli tovushdan oldin 'an'.

items.s: Visible mending has became popular among young people.
items.fix: Visible mending has become popular among young people.
items.why: has + V3: become → has become (became — V2).

16.title: Board Game: Passage 3 question types and fashion
16.stage: Workbook matni (Making a loss…) tekshirilgandan keyin, Practice 1 dan oldin (20 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
16.goal: Passage 3 strategiyasi (MCQ turlari, Y/N/NG = muallif fikri, sentence endings), paraphrase va kiyim/moda mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: qoidani tushuntiradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni ustoz kalitidagi namunaga solishtiradi; ochiq savollarda mazmunli va grammatik to'g'ri javob qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato yoki chala bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Y/N/NG questions: about facts or about the writer's views?
squares.a: The writer's views and claims.

squares.t: Say it another way: 'a garment'.
squares.a: e.g. a piece of clothing / an item of clothing

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds about your favourite outfit.
squares.a: e.g. My favourite outfit is jeans and a white shirt because…

squares.t: cloth or clothes? 'He changed his ___ after the match.'
squares.a: clothes

squares.t: Name two phrases that show the writer's opinion.
squares.a: e.g. in my view, unfortunately, it is a pity, there's no doubt

squares.t: One word: 'easily broken or damaged'
squares.a: fragile (also accept: delicate)

squares.t: MCQ: which question should you answer LAST?
squares.a: The 'most suitable title' question.

squares.t: The writer never mentions the idea in the statement. Y, N or NG?
squares.a: NOT GIVEN

squares.t: Say the adjectives: decoration / durability / extravagance
squares.a: decorative / durable / extravagant

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'There is no doubt that…'
squares.a: e.g. It is clear / certain that… / Undoubtedly, …

squares.t: Would you wear second-hand clothes? Why or why not?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — they are cheaper and better for the environment.

squares.t: Sentence endings: 6 endings, 4 questions. How many are extra?
squares.a: Two.

squares.t: What is the difference between NO and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: NO: the writer says the opposite; NG: the writer says nothing about it.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'good value for money'
squares.a: e.g. worth the price / not overpriced

squares.t: What does 'conservation' of old clothes mean?
squares.a: Protecting and caring for old garments so that they are not damaged.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'repair clothes instead of throwing them away'
squares.a: e.g. mend garments rather than discard them

squares.t: MCQ 'writer's purpose': what do you look for?
squares.a: What the paragraph DOES: describe, explain, compare, criticise…

squares.t: Part 3: Why do people pay so much for designer labels?
squares.a: e.g. Status — a famous label shows wealth and taste.

squares.t: MCQ: why is an option with the same word as the text often a trap?
squares.a: The word may be used with a different meaning; match ideas, not words.

squares.t: Finish: 'The fabric was so fragile that…'
squares.a: e.g. …it had to be cleaned by hand.

squares.t: Part 3: Should schools teach students to repair clothes?
squares.a: e.g. Yes — it saves money and reduces waste.

squares.t: Describe a traditional Uzbek fabric, e.g. atlas or adras.
squares.a: e.g. Atlas is a silk fabric with bright, blurred patterns.

squares.t: Part 3: Is fast fashion good or bad for society?
squares.a: e.g. Both: cheap for buyers, but wasteful and harmful to the environment.

squares.t: Explain the 'main topic of a paragraph' MCQ rule.
squares.a: Choose the option that covers the whole paragraph, not one detail.

16.title: Dominoes: sentence endings about fashion
16.stage: Sentence endings qoidalari tushuntirilgandan keyin yoki Practice 1 dan oldin isitish (12 daqiqa); darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi
16.goal: Matching sentence endings mashqi: gap boshini ma'no VA grammatika jihatdan mos tugallanma bilan ulash (because, so that, whereas, if, to kabi bog'lovchilarga qarab).

17.goal: Tikish, mato va kiyim tarixi mavzusidagi gaplarda tipik xatolarni (ko'plik -s, sifat darajasi, didn't + V1, originate — majhul emas, sanalmaydigan ot, take up + -ing) topish — Section 4 javobi gapga grammatik mos kelishi shart.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.

17.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida, uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
17.goal: Section 4 strategiyasi gaplari va ma'ruzachining signal iboralari (Now, … / So the point is … / Moving on, …) bilan boshlanadigan gaplarni to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
Signal ibora bilan boshlangan gapni (Now, … / So the point is … / Moving on, …) ma'ruzachi ohangida o'qib bergan jamoa +1 bonus oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Read all ten sentences before the recording starts.
Decide whether each gap needs a noun or an adjective.
Write the exact words that the speaker uses.
Spelling mistakes and missing plurals lose marks.
Now, let's look at how the zip got its name.
So the point is that the cloth needed to be warm.

Metal rivets stopped the pockets from tearing away.

17.title: Quiz Board: Section 4 — lectures, gaps and fabrics
17.stage: Dars oxirida yoki Mock test 2 oldidan: Section 4 va Unit 8 lug'atini takrorlash (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
17.goal: Section 4 sentence completion qoidalari, paraphrase, tikish / mato so'zlari va mavzu bo'yicha gapirishni jamoaviy o'yin orqali takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Paraphrase it 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Paraphrase it' va 'Say it!' savollarida kalitdagidan boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi; 'Fabric words' javobi harflab to'g'ri aytilsa — +50 bonus.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Grammar Auction: Unit 1–8 topic sentences
18.stage: 'Olti sabab' bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi darsda: 2-sabab — yozishdagi xatolar (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Unit 1–8 mavzularidagi (madaniyat shoki, organik ovqat, til o'rganish, yangi media, energiya, xarid va bank, munosabatlar, moda) gaplarda Band 5–6 tipik xatolarini topish: predlog, sifat darajasi, so'z turi, ega-kesim mosligi, artikl.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling; har jamoaga auksion varag'i va 1000 'pul' bering.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi (har gap Unit 1–8 mavzularidan biriga oid). Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va gap qaysi unit mavzusiga oidligini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'adjust to — Unit 1').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Many students feel homesick during their first months abroad.
items.why: feel + sifat (homesick); during + vaqt oralig'i — to'g'ri.

items.s: Newcomers often find it difficult to adjust a new culture.
items.fix: Newcomers often find it difficult to adjust to a new culture.
items.why: adjust to + ot: 'to' predlogi tushib qolmaydi.

items.s: Many people believe that organic food is more healthier.
items.fix: Many people believe that organic food is healthier.
items.why: healthy → healthier; 'more' qo'shilmaydi.

items.s: Solar panels generate electricity without burning fossil fuels.
items.why: without + -ing (burning) — to'g'ri.

items.s: Children learn their first language gradual, not all at once.
items.fix: Children learn their first language gradually, not all at once.
items.why: Fe'lni ravish izohlaydi: gradual → gradually.

items.s: Supermarkets often place sweets near the tills to tempt shoppers.
items.why: to + V1 — maqsad; tempt — vasvasaga solmoq.

items.s: The number of amateur journalists have grown rapidly.
items.fix: The number of amateur journalists has grown rapidly.
items.why: Ega — 'the number' (birlik): has grown.

items.s: Paying bills by direct debit saves time and avoids late fees.
items.why: -ing bilan boshlangan ega birlik: saves, avoids.

items.s: Wind farms can have a negative effect to local wildlife.
items.fix: Wind farms can have a negative effect on local wildlife.
items.why: have an effect on — to'g'ri predlog 'on'.

items.s: Trust is easy to lose but hard to rebuild.
items.why: sifat + to + V1: easy to lose, hard to rebuild.

items.s: Fashion industry produces a huge amount of waste every year.
items.fix: The fashion industry produces a huge amount of waste every year.
items.why: Aniq soha nomi: 'the fashion industry' — artikl kerak.

items.s: Durable clothes are better value for money than cheap ones.
items.why: better value for money than … — to'g'ri qiyoslash.

18.title: Board Game: Mock 2 review — question types, bands and plans
18.stage: Mockdan keyingi takror darsida: savol turlari, paraphrase va band jadvali (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Unit 1–8 savol turlari qoidalari, xom ball → band, olti xato sababi, paraphrase va imtihon tajribasi haqida gapirishni og'zaki takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'yinchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering; hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: savol turi qoidasini aytadi, paraphrase qiladi, bandni topadi yoki mock haqida gapiradi.
Guruh javobni ustoz bergan kalit varag'i bilan tekshiradi; paraphrase va gapirish kataklarida boshqa to'g'ri variantlar ham qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Band kataklarida doskadagi xom ball — band jadvalidan foydalanish mumkin emas.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida vaqtni o'ngdagi o'yinchi o'lchaydi; javobda raqam yoki aniq savol turi bo'lishi shart.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish). FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldindagi o'yinchi.

squares.t: How many questions are there in Listening and in Reading?
squares.a: 40 in each.

squares.t: TFNG: what is the difference between FALSE and NOT GIVEN?
squares.a: FALSE — the text says the opposite; NOT GIVEN — the text doesn't say.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'a newcomer'
squares.a: someone who has just arrived / a new arrival

squares.t: How long should you spend on each Reading passage?
squares.a: About 20 minutes (60 minutes for 3 passages).

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: which part of the mock was hardest?
squares.a: e.g. Reading Passage 3 — I ran out of time.

squares.t: Does YES / NO / NOT GIVEN check facts or the writer's views?
squares.a: The writer's views or claims.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'harmful'
squares.a: damaging / dangerous / bad for

squares.t: Matching headings: why are there more headings than paragraphs?
squares.a: Some headings are extra distractors and are not used.

squares.t: Listening: 26 correct answers. What band is it?
Paraphrase: 'on a large scale'
squares.a: widely / in large amounts / extensively

squares.t: Name at least four of the six reasons for wrong answers.
squares.a: Didn't hear/find; wrote it wrongly; no time; misread the task; guessed; changed it.

squares.t: Map labelling: say four direction phrases.
squares.a: e.g. opposite, next to, on your left, beyond, at the end of

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how have you changed since Unit 1?
squares.a: e.g. I read faster and notice paraphrases more easily.

squares.t: Summary with a word list: what do you check before choosing?
squares.a: The word type the gap needs and the meaning of the sentence.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'impulse buying'
squares.a: buying without planning / spontaneous purchases

squares.t: Key: 'Tuesdays'. You wrote 'Tuesday'. Which reason (1–6)?
squares.a: Reason 2 — heard it but wrote it wrongly (plural -s).

squares.t: Reading: 19 correct answers. What band is it?
Matching features: are the answers in text order?
squares.a: No — scan the whole text for the names.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'reliable'
squares.a: trustworthy / dependable

squares.t: Flow chart: in what order do the answers usually come?
squares.a: In the same order as the text or recording.

squares.t: Should you ever leave an answer blank? Why?
squares.a: No — a wrong answer loses nothing, so always write a guess.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: your two biggest error patterns and your plan.
squares.a: e.g. Headings and TFNG: one passage a day for two weeks.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'give rise to' about moving abroad.
squares.a: e.g. Moving abroad can give rise to homesickness.

squares.t: What raw scores do you need for 6.0 in Listening and Reading?
squares.a: 23 or more out of 40 in each.

18.title: Dominoes: question type ↔ its key rule
18.stage: 'Savol turi → Unit xaritasi' bosqichidan oldin: Unit 1–8 savol turlarini eslash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Unit 1–8 da o'rganilgan Reading va Listening savol turlarini asosiy qoidasi bilan bog'lash — har xatoga savol turini to'g'ri yozish va xaritadan qaytiladigan darsni topish uchun.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida savol turi yozilgan; shu turning asosiy qoidasi boshqa toshning chap tomonida. O'shani topib ulang.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har juftlikni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va har tur qaysi unitda o'rganilganini aytadi (3-mashq xaritasi bilan tekshiriladi).
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib; qo'shimcha +1: o'z mockidagi eng ko'p xato bo'lgan turni aytish.

checks the writer's views or claims

Summary completion with a word list

18.title: Taboo: topic words from Units 1–8
18.stage: Mock oldidan isitish (agar mock alohida o'tirishda bo'lsa) yoki keyingi dars boshida (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Unit 1–8 mavzu so'zlarini (culture shock, organic, fluency, amateur, renewable energy, bargain, overdraft, sibling, fabric…) inglizcha tushuntirish — paraphrase ko'nikmasini mustahkamlash.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball; so'z qaysi unit mavzusidan ekanini ham aytsa (masalan: 'overdraft — Unit 6, bank') +1 bonus.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha yoki ruscha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

18.title: Find someone who… finished Reading on time
18.stage: 'Natijani ochish' bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Mock va butun kurs tajribasi haqida Past Simple, Present Perfect va Present Simple bilan savol tuzish; natija, xato sabablari va reja haqida inglizcha gaplashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Did you finish the Reading section with time to spare?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why do you think that happened? What will you do next time?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin. Aniq ball va band so'ralmaydi — faqat tajriba.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytib beradi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

18.title: Speaking cards: exams, study and Unit 1–8 topics
18.stage: Keyingi dars boshida (Writing Task 1 oldidan) — Unit 1–8 mavzularida Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Imtihon va o'qish tajribasi hamda Unit 1–8 mavzulari (chet elda o'qish, ovqat, til, media, energiya, pul, munosabatlar, moda) bo'yicha Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga kengaytirilgan javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Juftlikda birinchi o'quvchi (examiner) karta oladi va savolni o'qiydi.
Sherigi javob beradi: shaxsiy (Part 1) savollarga 20–30 soniya, umumiy (Part 3) savollarga 40 soniya — fikr + sabab + misol.
Examiner Unit 1–8 lug'atidan (homesick, nutritious, fluency, reliable, sustainable, bargain, trust, durable…) nechtasi to'g'ri ishlatilganini sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

18.title: Sentence Race: exam strategy and my two-week plan
18.stage: 'Ikki haftalik reja' bosqichidan oldin: strategiya va reja gaplarini tuzish (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Imtihon strategiyasi (vaqt, bo'sh javob, FALSE / NOT GIVEN farqi, paraphrase) va ikki haftalik reja gaplarini to'g'ri so'z tartibida tuzish — rejani aniq va raqamli yozishga tayyorgarlik.
rules: Gaplarni so'zlarga qirqib, har gapni alohida konvertga soling; har jamoaga bitta konvert beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (bosh harf gap boshini, nuqta gap oxirini ko'rsatadi) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi.
'My main problem…' va 'For the next two weeks…' gaplarini o'z mock natijasiga moslab qayta aytgan o'quvchi jamoasiga +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: Spend about twenty minutes on each reading passage.

18.title: Quiz Board: Mock 2 — the whole IELTS 6.0 course
18.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichida yoki keyingi darsda: butun kurs takrori (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
18.goal: Savol turlari, paraphrase, xom ball → band, olti xato sababi va o'z rejasi haqida gapirishni jamoaviy o'yin orqali takrorlash.
materials: Xom ball — band jadvali (o'yin paytida yopiq turadi)
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 bo'lim × 5 katak (100–500). Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Scores & errors 300'); ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Paraphrase it' va 'Say it!' savollarida kalitdagidan boshqa to'g'ri javob ham qabul qilinadi; 'Say it!' da javob beruvchi o'quvchini jamoa tanlaydi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: Which Listening section has one speaker and no pause?

Why are Matching features answers harder to find than TFNG answers?
