19.title: Grammar Auction: Is this good Task 1 language?
19.stage: Namuna javob tahlilidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Task 1 javobidagi tipik xatolarni topish va tuzatish: fikr va sabab qo'shish (TA), noaniq so'z va 'amount/number' (LR), zamon va moslashuv (GRA); har xatoni tegishli mezon bilan bog'lash.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bu gap Task 1 javobiga yaroqlimi yoki unda xato bormi (fikr, sabab, zamon, so'z tanlash)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gap uchun: birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan VA xato qaysi mezonga (TA / CC / LR / GRA) ta'sir qilishini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The bar chart compares the amount of time teenagers in Tashkent spent on four hobbies in 2024.
items.why: Kirish: 'shows' o'rniga 'compares' — to'g'ri paraphrase (TA).

items.s: In 2010 young people watches TV for three hours a day.
items.fix: In 2010 young people watched TV for three hours a day.
items.why: O'tgan yil — Past Simple: watched (GRA).

items.s: Overall, car ownership rose in all three countries, while bus use declined.
items.why: Overview: asosiy tendensiya, raqamsiz (TA).

items.s: The number of tourists who visited Samarkand were higher in 2023.
items.fix: The number of tourists who visited Samarkand was higher in 2023.
items.why: 'The number of …' — birlik fe'l: was (GRA).

items.s: Visits to the history museum more than tripled over the period.
items.why: Aniq ibora: more than tripled (LR).

items.s: In my opinion, the science museum was the least popular of the three.
items.fix: The science museum was the least popular of the three.
items.why: Task 1 da shaxsiy fikr yozilmaydi — faqat ma'lumot (TA).

items.s: The figures for Bukhara and Khiva were 30% and 25% respectively.
items.why: respectively — raqamlar nomlar tartibida keladi (LR).

items.s: Cinema attendance fell sharply because tickets became too expensive.
items.fix: Cinema attendance fell sharply.
items.why: Sabab grafikda ko'rsatilmagan — taxmin yozilmaydi (TA).

items.s: Time spent on homework increased slightly, from ten to eleven hours a week.
items.why: Tafsilot + raqam, aniq ravish: slightly (LR).

items.s: The amount of people using the metro rose significantly.
items.fix: The number of people using the metro rose significantly.
items.why: Sanaladigan ot (people) bilan 'number', 'amount' emas (LR).

items.s: By 2020, online sales had overtaken sales in traditional shops.
items.why: 'By + yil' — Past Perfect: had overtaken (GRA).

items.s: The figure for social media was very big in 2025.
items.fix: The figure for social media was very high in 2025.
items.why: Raqam 'big' emas, 'high' bo'ladi — kollokatsiya (LR).

19.title: Board Game: Task 1 facts and the four criteria
19.stage: Keyingi Writing darsi boshida 19-dars takrori sifatida (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Task 1 talablari (150 so'z, 20 daqiqa, 4 tur), 4 baholash mezoni, overview tushunchasi va paraphrase ('shows → illustrates') bo'yicha og'zaki takror.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi; javoblar kalitini guruhdagi bitta 'hakam' ushlab turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: savolga javob beradi, paraphrase qiladi yoki to'liq gap tuzadi.
Hakam kalit bilan tekshiradi: 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna — mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lsa qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: How many words must a Task 1 answer have?
squares.a: At least 150 words (160–190 is ideal).

squares.t: How long should you spend on Task 1?
squares.a: About 20 minutes.

squares.t: Name the four types of Task 1 visual.
squares.a: Graphs/charts, tables, processes and maps.

squares.t: Name three kinds of graph.
squares.a: Line graph, bar chart, pie chart.

squares.t: Which gives more marks: Task 1 or Task 2?
squares.a: Task 2 — it is worth twice as much as Task 1.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'The graph shows…'
squares.a: e.g. The graph illustrates / compares / gives information about…

squares.t: Can you write 'I think' in Task 1? Why?
squares.a: No — Task 1 reports the data only, with no opinions.

squares.t: What does TA stand for?
squares.a: Task Achievement.

squares.t: What do CC, LR and GRA stand for?
squares.a: Coherence and Cohesion; Lexical Resource; Grammatical Range and Accuracy.

squares.t: What is an overview?
squares.a: 1–2 sentences on the main trends or biggest differences, with no numbers.

squares.t: Say it better: 'The number was very big.'
squares.a: e.g. The figure was very high. / It was the highest figure.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'from 2010 to 2020'
squares.a: e.g. over a ten-year period / over the decade

squares.t: Correct: 'In 2019 the museum have 5,000 visitors.'
squares.a: In 2019 the museum had 5,000 visitors.

squares.t: No paragraphs at all — which criterion suffers?
squares.a: Coherence and Cohesion (CC).

squares.t: No overview — which criterion suffers?
squares.a: Task Achievement (TA) — usually no higher than Band 5.

squares.t: Give two linkers for contrast.
squares.a: e.g. whereas, by contrast, however, while

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'respectively'.
squares.a: e.g. The figures for A and B were 40% and 25% respectively.

squares.t: Should you end with your opinion? What do you write instead?
squares.a: No. A clear overview (Overall, …) is enough.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'overtake'.
squares.a: e.g. In 2020 online sales overtook sales in shops.

squares.t: Why shouldn't you describe every number?
squares.a: The task says 'selecting' — choose only the main features.

squares.t: Speaking: Do you prefer information in charts or in text? Why?
squares.a: e.g. Charts — I can see the main trend at a glance.

squares.t: Give an overview: TV fell, the internet rose a lot.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, TV viewing declined, while internet use rose dramatically.

squares.t: Say one thing Band 7 needs in each of the 4 criteria.
squares.a: e.g. clear overview; logical order; precise words; accurate complex sentences

squares.t: Explain Task 1 to a new student in 20 seconds.
squares.a: e.g. 150+ words, 20 minutes, select main features, compare, no opinions.

19.title: Dominoes: criteria and Task 1 words ↔ meanings
19.stage: To'rt mezon (slaydlar 8–13) tushuntirilgandan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: 4 baholash mezonini 'boshqacha aytganda' izohi bilan, Task 1 ning asosiy so'zlarini (illustrate, proportion, respectively, overtake, whereas…) ta'rifi bilan bog'lash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam qirqilgan domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng yarmidagi mezon yoki so'zga mos ta'rif qaysi toshning chap yarmida ekanini toping va ulang.
Shu tarzda zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring: har so'z faqat bitta ta'rifga mos keladi. Maslahat: fe'llarning ko'pi 'to …', daraja ravishlari 'by …' bilan ta'riflangan.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz kalit bilan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi tugatgan guruh o'qiydi.
Bonus: tayyor zanjirdagi istalgan 3 so'z bilan Task 1 gapi tuzgan guruh +1 ball oladi.

pairs: covers the task and gives a clear overview
to show information in a chart or diagram
a part or share of the whole
logical order, paragraphs and linking words
in the same order as the items mentioned
to go past something that was ahead
a wide and precise range of vocabulary
became over three times as large
joins two contrasting facts in one sentence
to look at how things are similar or different
varied sentence structures with few errors
in general; looking at the whole picture
by a large or important amount
a length of time, e.g. from 2010 to 2020
a change to the opposite position

19.title: Taboo: Task 1 words and visuals
19.stage: Sinf mashqlaridan keyin, CORE/STRONG/SUPER so'zlar takrori (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Task 1 lug'atini (illustrate, proportion, respectively, overtake, whereas…) va vizual turlari nomlarini (pie chart, line graph, process diagram, map) inglizcha ta'riflash.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.

60 soniyada so'zni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi. Task 1 dan misol keltirish mumkin (masalan: 'In a chart, when A becomes bigger than B…').
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi, ular topsa +1 ball.
Imo-ishora va havoda grafik chizish mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.title: Find someone who… has made a chart
19.stage: Dars boshida, 'Kirish' bosqichi o'rniga harakatli isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Grafik, raqam va Task 1 mavzusidagi tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Have you ever…? / Do you…? / Can you…?) va natijani 'most / a large proportion / only a few' bilan xulosalash.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever made a chart in Excel?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? What did it show?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi. So'ng 2–3 o'quvchi natijani Task 1 uslubida aytadi: 'A large proportion of the class has…', 'Only a few students…'.

items.t: …has made a chart in Excel or Google Sheets.
items.q: Have you ever made a chart in Excel or Google Sheets?

items.t: …checks the weather forecast on an app every morning.
items.q: Do you check the weather forecast on an app every morning?

items.t: …has seen a pie chart in the news this month.
items.q: Have you seen a pie chart in the news this month?

items.t: …can name all four IELTS Writing criteria.
items.q: Can you name all four IELTS Writing criteria?

items.t: …has already written a Task 1 answer at home.
items.q: Have you already written a Task 1 answer at home?

items.t: …checks their screen time on their phone every week.
items.q: Do you check your screen time on your phone every week?

items.t: …spends more time on Telegram than on Instagram.
items.q: Do you spend more time on Telegram than on Instagram?

items.t: …would rather describe a map than a process.
items.q: Would you rather describe a map than a process?

items.t: …has used a map app to find a new place this week.
items.q: Have you used a map app to find a new place this week?

items.t: …has followed a recipe with step-by-step photos.
items.q: Have you ever followed a recipe with step-by-step photos?

items.t: …knows what percentage of their day they spend sleeping.
items.q: Do you know what percentage of your day you spend sleeping?

items.t: …thinks Task 1 is harder than Task 2.
items.q: Do you think Task 1 is harder than Task 2?

19.title: Speaking cards: numbers, charts and free time
19.stage: Keyingi dars boshida yoki Speaking darsida, IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Raqamlar, grafiklar, bo'sh vaqt va statistika mavzusida IELTS Speaking Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga kengaytirilgan javob berish va Task 1 so'zlarini og'zaki ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 20–40 soniya javob beradi: oddiy savollarga 2–3 gap, 'Why?' li savollarga sabab va misol bilan 4–5 gap.
Tinglovchi javobdagi Task 1 so'zlarini (figure, proportion, significantly, overall, whereas…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you like working with numbers? Why or why not?
How often do you see charts or graphs in your daily life? Where?
Did you learn to read graphs at school? Was it easy for you?
Do you prefer getting information from a chart or from a text? Why?
How do you usually spend your free time on weekdays and at weekends?
How has the way young people spend their free time changed in the last ten years?
Why do you think news websites often use charts and infographics?
Can statistics sometimes be misleading? Can you give an example?
Do you use paper maps or map apps? Which do you prefer and why?
Should school students learn how to read and analyse data? Why?
How much time do you spend on your phone each day? Would you like to change that?
Which jobs require people to analyse numbers and charts every day?
Do people trust numbers more than opinions? Why do you think so?
If you drew a pie chart of your typical day, what would the biggest slice be?

19.title: Sentence Race: Task 1 sentences
19.stage: 'To'rt misol' (slaydlar 4–7) dan keyin, namuna javob tahlilidan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Task 1 gaplarining to'g'ri tuzilishi: kirish (The chart compares…), overview (Overall, …), tafsilot (rose slightly, from … to …) va Task 1 qoidalari.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning qirqilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism tugashi.
Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa qo'l ko'taradi va gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert; xato bo'lsa jamoa qayta teradi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — oxirgi gapni tezroq tergan jamoa.

sentences: The pie charts compare how students spend their pocket money.
The bar chart gives information about fruit exports from five regions of Uzbekistan.
Task 1 answers never include personal opinions.
Overall, television lost much of its popularity among young people.
Car use fell slightly, whereas the number of cyclists more than tripled.
The number of museum visitors more than doubled after 2015.
A large proportion of students chose football as their main sport.
Monthly phone sales rose slightly, from 200 to 210.
An answer without an overview rarely scores above Band 5.

19.title: Quiz Board: Task 1 and the four criteria
19.stage: 'Xulosa va vazifa' bosqichidan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
19.goal: Task 1 talablari, 4 baholash mezoni, Task 1 lug'ati va paraphrase/overview tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Say it! 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniya maslahatlashib, bitta vakil orqali javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
'Say it!' bo'limida 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna: mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lgan har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: What is the minimum number of words for Task 1?
How many minutes should you spend on Task 1?
Name the four types of Task 1 visual.
The task says: 'Summarise the information by ___ and reporting the main features.' Missing word?
Why is writing 250 words for Task 1 a bad idea?
qs.a: No extra marks; less time for Task 2 and more risk of errors

qs.q: What does TA stand for?
The whole answer is one block with no paragraphs. Which criterion suffers?
'The number was very big and nice.' Which criterion suffers?
'In 2010 the museum have 900 visitors.' Which criterion suffers?
Without an overview, TA is usually no higher than which band?
A part or share of a whole: p________
'The figures for sport and music were 6 and 4 hours ___' (in the same order as mentioned).
Give a verb that is the opposite of 'increase'.
A figure went from 4 to 14. Complete: it more than t______.
A was behind B, then became bigger than B. One verb: A ___ B.
Paraphrase: 'The graph shows…'
Paraphrase: 'from 2015 to 2025'
qs.a: e.g. over a ten-year period / over the decade

qs.q: Start an overview sentence for any chart.
qs.a: e.g. Overall, the most striking change was…

qs.q: Contrast in ONE sentence: TV fell; social media rose.
qs.a: e.g. TV viewing fell, whereas social media use rose.

qs.q: Make it Task 1-friendly: 'I think people read less because they are lazy.'
qs.a: e.g. Time spent reading decreased. (no opinion, no reason)

20.title: Grammar Auction: rise, rose or raised?
20.stage: Namuna (grafik → reja → javob) tahlilidan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Tendensiya tilidagi tipik xatolarni topish: rise/rose/raise, 'increase by', 'reach' predlogsiz, 'a sharp fall' (sifat + ot) va overview'da raqam yozmaslik qoidasi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: tendensiya tili (fe'l shakli, predlog, sifat/ravish) va overview qoidasi to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'rise — rose — risen, rised yo'q').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Car ownership rose steadily throughout the period.
items.why: rise → rose; steadily + throughout — to'g'ri tendensiya tili.

items.s: The number of cyclists rised sharply in 2019.
items.fix: The number of cyclists rose sharply in 2019.
items.why: rise — noto'g'ri fe'l: rise – rose – risen ('rised' yo'q).

items.s: Bus use peaked at 60% in 2016 and then declined.
items.why: peak at + raqam; so'ng declined — to'g'ri.

items.s: There was a sharply fall in cinema visits after 2018.
items.fix: There was a sharp fall in cinema visits after 2018.
items.why: Ot oldida sifat keladi: a sharp fall (sharply — ravish).

items.s: Sales remained stable at around 500 units a month.
items.why: remain + sifat (stable) + at + raqam — to'g'ri.

items.s: The price of bread raised sharply in 2022.
items.fix: The price of bread rose sharply in 2022.
items.why: raise — biror narsani ko'tarmoq (o'timli); o'zi oshsa — rose.

items.s: Overall, cycling and walking followed a similar pattern.
items.why: Overview: umumiy naqsh, raqamsiz — to'g'ri.

items.s: Exports increased with 20% over the decade.
items.fix: Exports increased by 20% over the decade.
items.why: O'zgarish miqdori 'by' bilan: increased by 20%.

items.s: The number of visitors fluctuated between 200 and 300.
items.why: fluctuate between … and … — to'g'ri.

items.s: Overall, the number of drivers rose from 2.1 to 3.4 million.
items.fix: Overall, the number of drivers rose considerably.
items.why: Overview'da raqam yozilmaydi — raqamlar P3–P4 ga.

items.s: The share of online sales grew gradually, reaching a peak of 70% in 2022.
items.why: grew gradually + reaching a peak of — to'g'ri.

items.s: The number of tourists reached to one million in 2023.
items.fix: The number of tourists reached one million in 2023.
items.why: reach — predlogsiz: reached one million ('to' kerak emas).

20.title: Board Game: question types, formula and plans
20.stage: Sinf mashqlaridan keyin, 'Taymer: uchta reja' dan oldin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: 4 savol turini aniqlash, 4 xatboshili formula, reja belgilarini (↑ ↓ → ++ ≈) gapga aylantirish va tendensiya fe'llari + ravishlarni og'zaki mashq qilish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi; javoblar kalitini guruhdagi bitta 'hakam' ushlab turadi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni inglizcha bajaradi: turini aytadi, reja belgisini gapga aylantiradi yoki tendensiya gapini tuzadi.
Hakam kalit bilan tekshiradi: 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna — mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lsa qabul qilinadi.
Xato yoki javob yo'q bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Say the past forms: rise, fall.
squares.a: rise – rose – risen; fall – fell – fallen

squares.t: Say the opposite: 'increased steadily'.
squares.a: decreased / declined steadily

squares.t: Name the four Task 1 question types.
squares.a: Graph with time, comparison graph (no time), process, map.

squares.t: How many paragraphs does the formula have? Name them.
squares.a: Four: introduction, overview, key details 1, key details 2.

squares.t: What goes in Paragraph 1?
squares.a: One sentence that paraphrases the question.

squares.t: What goes in the overview? Numbers or no numbers?
squares.a: The two main general features — no numbers.

squares.t: Which type? 'The graph shows oil prices from 2000 to 2020.'
squares.a: Graph with time — language of change (rose, fell, peaked).

squares.t: Which type? 'The pie chart shows the favourite sports of 300 students.'
squares.a: Comparison graph (no time) — higher than, the largest share.

squares.t: Which type? 'The diagram shows how paper is recycled.'
squares.a: Process — passive + sequence (is collected, after that, finally).

squares.t: Which type? 'The maps show a school campus in 2005 and 2025.'
squares.a: Map — location + change (was built, was replaced, to the north of).

squares.t: Read the plan aloud: 'A ↑↑'
squares.a: e.g. A rose dramatically.

squares.t: Read the plan aloud: 'B ↑ → ↓'
squares.a: e.g. B rose at first, then fell.

squares.t: Read the plan aloud: 'C ≈'
squares.a: e.g. C remained stable / almost unchanged.

squares.t: Read the plan aloud: 'D ++'
squares.a: e.g. D was the highest throughout the period.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'peaked at'.
squares.a: e.g. Sales peaked at 900 units in 2016.

squares.t: Make a sentence with 'fluctuated'.
squares.a: e.g. Prices fluctuated between $5 and $8.

squares.t: Say it with a noun: 'Prices rose sharply.'
squares.a: There was a sharp rise / increase in prices.

squares.t: An overview AND a summary in one answer — OK? Why?
squares.a: No. Write one of them, never both — it is repetition.

squares.t: Why do we put the overview in Paragraph 2?
squares.a: The examiner sees the key Task Achievement point at once.

squares.t: Process: stages 1–5 on a farm, 6–10 in a factory. Group P3/P4.
squares.a: P3: stages 1–5 (farm); P4: stages 6–10 (factory).

squares.t: Split the 20 minutes: plan, write, check.
squares.a: 2 minutes to plan + 15 to write + 3 to check.

squares.t: Paraphrase: 'between 2010 and 2020'.
squares.a: e.g. over a ten-year period / over the decade

squares.t: Overview: A highest all the time; B and C rose, then fell.
squares.a: e.g. Overall, A was the highest throughout, while B and C rose before declining.

squares.t: Using 3 trend words, say how your phone use has changed in 5 years.
squares.a: e.g. It rose steadily, peaked last year and has levelled off since.

20.title: Dominoes: rose sharply ↔ a sharp rise
20.stage: '4 savol turi' dan keyin, o'zgarish tili mashqi (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Tendensiyani ikki usulda aytish: fe'l + ravish (rose sharply) ↔ sifat + ot (a sharp rise) — Task 1 da takrordan qochish uchun paraphrase.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam qirqilgan domino toshini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng yarmidagi fe'l + ravishga (masalan, 'fell sharply') mos sifat + ot shakli ('a sharp fall') yozilgan toshni toping va ulang.
Zanjirni FINISH gacha davom ettiring. Maslahat: ko'p juftlikda fe'l va ot, ravish va sifat bir xil o'zakdan (fell sharply → a sharp fall, dramatically → dramatic).
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni o'qiydi va har juftlik bilan bitta gap aytadi (masalan: 'There was a sharp fall in sales.'); ustoz tekshiradi.
Zanjiri to'g'ri va gaplari xatosiz birinchi guruh g'olib.

20.title: Taboo: trend words and the formula
20.stage: Namuna grafikdan oldin, tendensiya so'zlarini isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Tendensiya so'zlari (peak, decline, fluctuate, level off, gradually…) va formula atamalarini (overview, paragraph, plan) inglizcha tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniyada so'zni jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi. Qo'l bilan havoda chiziq chizib ko'rsatish mumkin (tepaga, pastga, tekis).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi, ular topsa +1 ball.
Imo-ishora va havoda grafik chizish mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

20.title: Find someone who… makes a plan first
20.stage: Dars boshida, 'Takrorlash' dan keyin harakatli isitish (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: O'zgarish, reja va jarayon mavzusidagi tajriba haqida to'g'ri savol tuzish (Present Perfect / Present Simple) va javobda tendensiya so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni O'ZLARI tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Have you ever made a plan before writing an essay?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va tendensiya so'zi talab qiladigan qo'shimcha savol beradi (How much did it rise? When did it peak?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 2 ta natijani tendensiya tili bilan aytadi (masalan: 'Aziz's marks have risen steadily').

items.t: …has made a plan before writing an essay.
items.q: Have you ever made a plan before writing an essay?

items.t: …has seen the price of something rise sharply this year.
items.q: Have you seen the price of something rise sharply this year?

items.t: …checks currency exchange rates regularly.
items.q: Do you check currency exchange rates regularly?

items.t: …spends more time on their phone now than two years ago.
items.q: Do you spend more time on your phone now than two years ago?

items.t: …has taken part in a running event.
items.q: Have you ever taken part in a running event?

items.t: …has seen their marks improve steadily this year.
items.q: Have you seen your marks improve steadily this year?

items.q: Have you followed a recipe step by step this month?

items.q: Have you noticed a new building in your neighbourhood this year?

items.q: Do you write a to-do list every morning?

items.q: Can you explain the difference between an overview and a summary?

items.t: …has used a paper map to find their way in a new city.
items.q: Have you ever used a paper map to find your way in a new city?

items.t: …thinks a line graph is easier to describe than a map.
items.q: Do you think a line graph is easier to describe than a map?

20.title: Speaking cards: changes, trends and planning
20.stage: Keyingi dars boshida yoki Speaking darsida, IELTS Speaking Part 1/3 (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: O'zgarishlar (narxlar, shahar, sport, texnologiya) va rejalashtirish mavzusida Part 1 va Part 3 savollariga tendensiya tili bilan (rose steadily, peaked, levelled off) javob berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 20–40 soniya javob beradi: Part 1 savollariga 2–3 gap, Part 3 ('Why…?', 'How will…?') savollariga sabab va misol bilan 4–5 gap.
Tinglovchi javobdagi tendensiya so'zlarini (rise, fall, peak, remain stable, gradually, sharply…) sanaydi: har biri +1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Do you usually make a plan before you start writing or studying? Why?
How has your use of social media changed over the last few years?
Which sports have become more popular among young people in Uzbekistan?
Which prices have risen most sharply in your city recently?
How has your town or neighbourhood changed in the last ten years?
Do you think planning saves time or wastes time? Why?
Why do some trends, like new apps or games, rise quickly and then fall?
How do you think the number of cars in Tashkent will change in the future?
Do you prefer to follow step-by-step instructions or work things out yourself?
Is it important for students to understand graphs in the news? Why?
What is one skill you have improved steadily this year? How?
Why do you think more young people are studying abroad nowadays?
How do you organise your ideas before giving a talk or presentation?
What changes would you like to see in your city in the next five years?

20.title: Sentence Race: sentences for the 4-paragraph formula
20.stage: Formula (slayd 17) tushuntirilgandan keyin, 'Nega reja kerak' dan oldin (8 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: Formula gaplari: kirish (illustrates how many…), overview (Overall, …), tafsilot (fell dramatically, ending … at …), jarayon (passiv), xarita (was replaced by) va formula qoidalari.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning qirqilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Maslahat: bosh harfli so'z — gap boshi, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri, vergulli so'z — birinchi qism tugashi.

Tayyor bo'lgach, jamoa gapni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. To'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert; gap Task 1 ning qaysi turiga (vaqtli grafik / jarayon / xarita) yoki qaysi qoidaga tegishli ekanini aytsa +1 bonus.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — oxirgi gapni tezroq tergan jamoa.

sentences: The line graph illustrates how many people cycled to work over a decade.
Overall, sales of e-books more than doubled.
After that, the cocoa beans are roasted at a high temperature.
The farmland was replaced by a housing estate.
In our formula, the overview goes in Paragraph 2.
Write an overview, but never add a summary as well.
Bus use fell dramatically, ending the decade at just 15%.
After peaking in 2016, car sales fell sharply.
Put lines with similar trends in the same paragraph.

20.title: Quiz Board: types, formula and trend words
20.stage: Dars oxirida, 'Xulosa va vazifa' dan oldin umumiy takror (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takror uchun.
20.goal: 4 savol turi, 4 xatboshili formula, tendensiya so'zlari va reja/overview tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing (4 ustun × 100–500). Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Say it! 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniya maslahatlashib, bitta vakil orqali javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin (to'g'ri bo'lsa ball ularga).
'Say it!' bo'limida 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblar namuna: mazmuni va grammatikasi to'g'ri bo'lgan har qanday javob qabul qilinadi.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: 'The diagram shows how glass is recycled.' Which type?
'The maps show a park in 2000 and now.' Which type?
'The bar chart compares the heights of five famous towers.' Which type?
'The table shows ticket sales for each month of 2023.' Which type?
qs.a: Graph with time — time decides the type, not the visual

qs.q: Which language does a process answer need?
qs.a: Passive + sequencers (is heated; after that; finally)

qs.q: How many paragraphs are in the Task 1 formula?
What does Paragraph 1 do?
qs.a: Paraphrases the question in one sentence

qs.q: Which paragraph is the overview?
Overview and summary: how many should you write?
qs.a: Exactly one — never both, never none

qs.q: Map: a new airport in the east, a new shopping centre in the west. How do you group P3 and P4?
qs.a: One paragraph per area: the east (airport), the west (shopping centre)

qs.q: Past simple of 'rise'?
Reached its highest point = it ___
Went up and down again and again = it ___
Noun phrase for 'rose sharply': a sharp ___
Stopped rising and stayed flat = it ___ off
Read the plan: 'Y ↓↓'
Paraphrase: 'The chart shows…'
Say a sentence with 'remained stable at'.
qs.a: e.g. Prices remained stable at around $5.

qs.q: Say it with a noun: 'Sales fell slightly.'
qs.a: e.g. There was a slight fall / drop in sales.

qs.q: Overview: A was highest throughout; B rose steadily; C fell.
qs.a: e.g. Overall, A was the highest, whereas B rose and C fell.
